item.title: Earth Surface Immune System for Rapid Monitoring of Unknown Anomalies
item.description:
作者：Jingtao Li, Qian Zhu, Xinyu Wang, Deren Li, Liangpei Zhang, Yanfei Zhong

Abstract: Earth surface anomalies, driven by escalating climate change, and expanding human activities, are increasing in both frequency and diversity, yet their limited historical data and unpredictability make them fundamentally different from conventional remote sensing targets. Existing methods address specific anomaly categories or stop at localization, leaving a gap between detection and actionable information. Here we present ESIA, an Earth Surface Immune System whose architecture is constrained by three principles from the biological immune system, refined over millions of years against equally diverse and uncertain threats. A non-specific innate immune stage treats anomalies as unobserved changes in time-series satellite imagery, generating binary localization maps at 14.51 km2/s without assuming any anomaly category, surpassing the strongest general baseline by 37% in F1. A specific adaptive immune stage applies negative selection to filter text prompts and matches surviving prompts with localized image patches through a multi-modal foundation model, enabling open-vocabulary recognition of unknown anomaly attributes including category, affected area, and damage severity, with recognition F1 exceeding 80%. A mutation mechanism tunes minimal embeddings at test time, adapting to each scene in 3.26s using a single reference image pair. We validate ESIA on a global-scale dataset covering 19,801.60 km2 across six anomaly categories, comparing against 22 models, and further apply it to quantify degraded farmland in the Dnipro Delta following the Kakhovka Dam collapse and assess burn severity from 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles. This unprecedented flexibility in handling unknown anomalies opens new avenues for real-time disaster response and environmental surveillance.

相关度：55/100 关键词命中：Remote Sensing、Foundation Model

item.title: Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents
item.description:
中文标题：Chronicle：面向LLM智能体回归测试的切点回放

作者：Tisha Chawla, Susheem Koul

Abstract: Large language model responses are non-deterministic, so failures in LLM agents are hard to reproduce: a failure depends on inference that is not bitwise reproducible, on tools that read changing state, and on a multi-step trajectory that a re-run rarely repeats. Record-and-replay makes a run reproducible, but existing agent tooling records runs only to trace or score them, not to test a code change against them. We present Chronicle, which records an agent run at its non-deterministic boundaries as immutable envelopes and replays it from the record. Its central operation, cut-point replay, serves a chosen subset of boundaries from the record and executes the complementary subset live with new code, turning a recorded incident into a regression test that runs in continuous integration. On a benchmark of 6 recorded failures with simulated model boundaries, recording adds 23 {\mu}s per crossing (0.008% of an assumed 300 ms model call), full replay issues zero model calls and is bit-stable across 20 repetitions, and cut-point tests fail on faulty code and pass on guarded and benign changes for all 6 incidents. In a mutation study of the guarded tools, cut-point tests catch every mutant that lets the recorded unsafe action through, while a baseline that stubs every boundary, using the same assertion, catches none. Chronicle and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle.

中文摘要：大语言模型响应具有非确定性，因此LLM智能体的失败难以复现：失败依赖于无法逐位复现的推理、读取变化状态的工具，以及重跑时很少重复的多步轨迹。记录-回放可使一次运行可复现，但现有智能体工具仅将运行记录下来用于追踪或评分，而非针对代码变更进行测试。我们提出Chronicle，它将智能体运行在其非确定性边界处记录为不可变信封，并从记录中回放。其核心操作——切点回放——从记录中提供选定边界子集，并用新代码实时执行互补子集，从而将一次记录的事故转化为可在持续集成中运行的回归测试。在一个包含6个记录失败并模拟模型边界的基准上，记录每次跨越增加23微秒（假设300毫秒模型调用的0.008%），完整回放发出零次模型调用且在20次重复中逐位稳定，切点测试对6个事故中的错误代码失败、对受保护和良性变更通过。在受保护工具的变异研究中，切点测试捕获了所有让记录的不安全动作通过的变异体，而使用相同断言对每个边界打桩的基线则一个都未捕获。Chronicle和基准已公开于https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将记录-回放从追踪/评分用途扩展到针对代码变更的回归测试，其切点回放机制可能为多智能体系统的测试与调试提供思路，但摘要未涉及地理空间数据或城市应用。

相关度：62/100 该论文聚焦LLM智能体的回归测试与可复现性，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: Value-Based Massive Access through Goal-Oriented Irregular Repetition Slotted ALOHA
item.description:
作者：Pietro Talli, Andrea Munari, Federico Mason, Federico Chiariotti, and Andrea Zanella

Abstract: Agents can now externalize experience into memory, consolidating historical traces into semantic knowledge and procedural shortcuts that persist between sessions. Such memory is typically private to a single agent. We argue that agentic memory benefits from being collective, because trustworthy knowledge of the shared environment---the data sources, services, and tools agents depend on---cannot be established by any single agent, only corroborated across many independent observers. We present Cairn, a community reputation platform that captures collective knowledge, allowing agents to query the community's opinion of a resource before use and to submit evidence-backed ratings afterward. Cairn aggregates observations via a time-decayed Beta model with confidence shrinkage and supports semantic discovery over reviewer rationales. We evaluate Cairn's reputation engine under adversarial simulation (e.g., lying, collusion, camouflage), benchmark its retrieval performance, and report a case study of rating heterogeneous agents in production. arXiv:2609.19176 (*cross-listing*) Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 06:37:29 GMT (1794kb) Title: Optimal Transport Metric Learning for Feature Alignment in Partially Supervised Segmentation Authors: Dakini Mallam Garba and Salim Abdou Daoura Categories: eess.IV cs.AI ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted for compliance and legal reasoning tasks, yet their outputs often lack explicit grounding in legal logic and evidence. We present Code-as-Auditor, an LLM-based framework that extends the model's reasoning capability toward structured and evidence-grounded compliance assessment. The framework translates regulatory information into (1) formalized checklists and executable decision trees, encoding regulations and conditions as interpretable code structures. During inference, each checklist item is (2) dynamically expanded into factual and counterfactual questions, guiding the model to reason over case-specific evidence and potential violations. This process establishes a reasoning pipeline that proceeds from evidence identification, through rule application, to final decision-making, while a self-verification loop improves the logical consistency of the generated code and the traceability of outcomes. Experiments on privacy and data protection scenarios demonstrate that Code-as-Auditor delivers more accurate and evidence-backed evaluations, enabling automated compliance regulation checking grounded in explicit regulatory criteria. arXiv:2609.19204 (*cross-listing*) Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:06:06 GMT (2845kb) Title: REACT: A Fully Spiking State-Space Model for Real-Time Event-Driven Temporal Perception Authors: Geoffroy Keime and Nicolas Cuperlier and Benoit R. Cottereau Categories: cs.RO cs.AI ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Autoregressive transformer decoding is constrained by irregular key-value (KV) cache movement on tiled accelerators. Prior compression and DRAM-placement systems still concentrate traffic on centralized memory paths that bottleneck long-context serving. We present MeshKV, a KV cache fabric that moves blocks as packetized flows over a lightweight NoC. It co-designs (i) TaKV affine striping to spread homes and cut hotspot load, (ii) Mare multicast with verified duplicate suppression, and (iii) Pad, which overlaps prefetch, tile multiply, and streaming softmax behind credit-aligned FIFOs. Together they convert bisection back-pressure into useful KV transfer. On our 8x8 FPGA implementation with LLaMA-2-7B and Mistral-7B at 8K-32K, MeshKV reduces interconnect traffic by up to 58%, improves KV bandwidth utilization by 2.1x, and delivers up to 1.9x multi-stream throughput. arXiv:2609.19210 (*cross-listing*) Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:27:08 GMT (145kb) Title: Not All Nodes Are Created Equal: Homophily-Aware Stratification for Stable GNN Evaluation Authors: Naga Venkata Sai Jitin Jami, Thomas Altstidl, Sebastian Hoefler, Jonas Mueller, Dario Zanca, Bjoern Eskofier, Heike Leutheuser Categories: cs.SI cs.AI cs.LG stat.ML Comments: 10 pages representativeness as a natural consequence of the procedure. We evaluate \hp{} on a broad benchmark suite comprising 15 node-classification datasets spanning the full homophily spectrum and 7 GNN architectures. \hp{} achieves a mean stability rank of 1.49 compared to 2.31 for random $k$-fold, achieving the lowest mean stability rank on 13 of 15 datasets while preserving class balance close to class-stratified splits and substantially better than random. We argue that homophily-aware split construction merits broader adoption for GNN evaluation. arXiv:2609.19215 (*cross-listing*) Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 12:33:08 GMT (1709kb) Title: Perceptual Refinement of an End-to-End Video Streaming Pipeline via Generative AI Layers Authors: Emanuele Artioli, Farzad Tashtarian, Christian Timmerer Categories: eess.IV cs.AI cs.CV cs.MM Comments: 28 pages. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications (TOMM), special issue on MMSys and co-located workshops. Extended version of the NOSSDAV 2025 paper ELVIS (arXiv:2512.14185). Code: https://github.com/emanuele-artioli/presley ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ AI-mediated platforms coordinate work through LLM agents acting for different principals. In these workflows, privacy loss can be created before a final answer appears: a memory write, shared-workspace update, inter-agent message, or tool event may impose downstream exposure cost on another principal. We model this failure mode as a privacy-propagation externality, where the cost of a raw disclosure depends on topology and fanout as well as content. We present PAPC, a platform-mediated mechanism that intercepts information-moving events before they update shared state or external channels. PAPC combines policy, provenance, topology/fanout, privilege, and content signals to allow an event, release a policy-safe abstraction, quarantine raw content, block a transition, or narrow onward rights. The model explains why final-output control misses intermediate exposure costs and why high-fanout objects amplify propagation. Across retrieval-memory and multi-agent workflow benchmarks, PAPC preserves deterministic task completion and eliminates measured exact raw-value and external raw-value exposure. The results position event-level mediation as a platform-governance primitive for agent-mediated online work. arXiv:2609.19234 (*cross-listing*) Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 16:00:34 GMT (59kb) Title: The AR Fairness Metamodel: A Structured Framework for Fairness Measures Authors: Julian Alfredo Mendez and Timotheus Kampik Categories: cs.CY cs.AI cs.LO cs.MA cs.PL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Large language models fine-tuned for network intrusion detection emit single-point predictions without statistical validity guarantees. Conformal prediction supplies a finite-sample coverage guarantee, but a threshold calibrated on clean traffic fails once an adversary perturbs controllable network features. We demonstrate this failure across three intrusion detection benchmarks and propose traffic-aware conformal prediction, which calibrates on traffic drawn from the perturbation mechanism an attacker is expected to use and provably restores coverage whenever that mechanism is known and can be sampled. A stronger, adaptive attacker that queries the target model's own score can still degrade this matched-calibration guarantee. We address this second threat model by excluding attacker-controllable features and their deterministic descendants from the scored representation, and prove that this yields an exact, pathwise coverage guarantee rather than a probabilistic bound. Across three independently fine-tuned language model architectures, this representation remains completely unchanged under every evaluated attack attempt, at a quantified seven-to-fourteen-point cost in clean accuracy relative to the unrestricted feature set. arXiv:2609.19290 (*cross-listing*) Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 18:02:24 GMT (4278kb) Title: Physics-Informed Hemodynamic Modeling for Data-Free Prediction and Sparse-Data Assimilation Authors: Xi Chen, Jianchuan Yang, Hongde Li, Guangxin He, Qiuyu Ye, Qiang Luo, Mao Chen, Wenqi Hu Categories: eess.IV cs.AI ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities. arXiv:2609.19325 (*cross-listing*) Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 18:45:24 GMT (621kb) Title: AUDITPLAN: Commit, Then Answer for Auditable Safety Alignment Authors: Sai Sri Pushpa Jampani and Kshitij Mishra and Asif Ekbal Categories: cs.CR cs.AI cs.CL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Robotic additive manufacturing (AM) extends material-extrusion printing beyond gantry kinematics but makes process planning robot-dependent. A slicer-generated plan that appears favorable in part coordinates can become infeasible or robotically unfavorable on a manipulator because slicer-process decisions and part orientation determine the generated path, while part orientation and workspace placement affect its kinematic realization. Existing AM tools, large language model (LLM)-based decision-support methods, and digital-shadow systems do not provide integrated pre-execution evaluation of these coupled decisions. This paper presents agentic robotic additive manufacturing (A-RAM), an agent-specialist-tool framework that converts user intent and a part file into traceable, execution-ready plans. The LLM interprets manufacturing objectives and constraints, identifies prescribed and searchable planning variables, and encodes this reasoning in a schema-constrained request; a deterministic Planning Agent instantiates the corresponding search workflow, while domain tools compute quantitative evidence for slicing, placement, inverse kinematics, trajectory timing, Joint-6 jerk, and extrusion. The framework is evaluated on a six-axis robotic-arm AM cell through three case studies covering expert-specified planning, goal-only planning, objective-dependent infill screening, and geometry-dependent orientation-placement selection. Across the evaluated candidate sets, selected plans achieve up to 53.5% lower maximum Joint-6 jerk and 48.3% lower mean absolute Joint-6 jerk than the least favorable valid candidates, while objective-specifi

item.title: Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task
item.description:
中文标题：语言模型群体在复现人类审议推理任务时高估共识

作者：Tengfei Shao

Abstract: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.

中文摘要：完全共识率常被视为集体认知的指标，却取决于参与和最终状态如何被操作化。我们用匹配的大语言模型（LLM）智能体群体复现了100个留出的人类Wason小组，为每位参与者讨论前的答案播种一个信念锚定智能体，并用相同代码对智能体和人类评分。在人类评分定义下，估计值从24.0%到57.0%不等；约五分之一参与者从未发帖，而智能体几乎总是发帖。智能体群体在两项揭盲后敏感性分析中仍更具共识性：基于提交的比较（n=98）在聊天和推理模式下分别产生34.0和43.9个百分点的差距，参与匹配比较（n=45）产生34.1和44.4个百分点的差距。这两条互补路径减少了不同的测量不对称性，却在0.5个百分点内收敛。该差距在无提前停止以及移除可记忆答案的重参数化下依然存在；推理模式群体随后几乎一致同意，且多同意错误答案。模拟共识并未追踪集体准确性，信念锚定智能体群体在此设定下是人类群体结果分布的有偏估计。这些分析为评估人类审议结果的模拟群体估计提供了评分明确的依据。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究揭示了LLM智能体群体在模拟人类审议时系统性高估共识，提示在多智能体仿真中需谨慎对待共识指标，但摘要未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

相关度：55/100 该论文研究LLM智能体群体在复现人类审议时的共识偏差，与LLM和多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市更新。

item.title: An Analysis of Training-Free Self-Reported Confidence in Language Models
item.description:
中文标题：语言模型中免训练自报置信度的分析

作者：Lukas Meyer, Sofia Rossi, Wei Chen, Thomas Laurent, Yiming Li

Abstract: Large language models can report a numerical confidence together with generated content, but it is unclear whether this report is more than calibrated rhetoric. We analyze three training-free signals: confidence verbalized with the answer, post-hoc $P(\mathrm{True})$, and agreement with three additional generations on the same 100 TriviaQA questions for two model families. Direct verbalization is a surprisingly strong baseline: after auditing benchmark errors, it reaches AUROC 0.956 and 0.937 for correctness prediction. Three-sample agreement is substantially weaker (0.765 and 0.790), and a fixed interpolation with verbalized confidence has no statistically reliable benefit. Four of nine errors from one model and two of eight from the other receive unanimous sample support, showing that self-consistency can amplify shared misconceptions. Re-eliciting confidence for the same fixed answers with equivalent prompts changes scores by 0.043 to 0.084 on average and flips 4\% to 9\% of decisions at a 0.8 threshold. An exploratory audit of 100 confidence-tagged biography claims further finds only a modest confidence gap between supported and contradicted claims. These results argue that useful self-reports remain sensitive to elicitation, correlated errors, and benchmark noise.

中文摘要：大语言模型可以在生成内容的同时报告一个数值置信度，但这一报告是否只是经过校准的修辞尚不清楚。本文分析了三种免训练信号：随答案口头表达的置信度、事后P(True)概率，以及在100个TriviaQA问题上与另外三次生成结果的一致性，覆盖两个模型家族。直接口头表达是一个出人意料的强基线：在审查基准错误后，其对正确性预测的AUROC达到0.956和0.937。三次采样一致性明显更弱（0.765和0.790），而与口头置信度的固定插值没有统计上可靠的收益。一个模型的九个错误中有四个、另一个模型的八个错误中有两个获得了一致的采样支持，表明自一致性可能放大共同的误解。用等价提示对相同固定答案重新引出置信度，平均会使分数变化0.043至0.084，并在0.8阈值下翻转4%至9%的决策。对100条带置信度标签的传记性陈述的探索性审查进一步发现，被支持与被反驳的陈述之间置信度差距仅为中等。这些结果表明，有用的自报置信度仍然对引出方式、相关错误和基准噪声敏感。

研究启发（模型推断）：若将LLM用于地理空间智能或多智能体决策，其自报置信度可作为不确定性信号，但需注意其对提示方式敏感且可能放大共同错误，因此不宜单独作为可靠性依据。

相关度：62/100 该文分析语言模型自报置信度的可靠性，涉及LLM评估与不确定性量化，与研究中LLM与多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: How Do Agent Harnesses Create Value? Planning Information and Release Control in Stateful LLM Agents
item.description:
中文标题：智能体框架如何创造价值？有状态LLM智能体中的规划信息与发布控制

作者：Yukun Zhang, Kemu Xu, Yishen Chen

Abstract: Agent harnesses supply planning guidance, organize execution, and check completion. We study how these components affect success, erroneous acceptance, and cost in two Retail experiments and an Airline pilot in $\tau^2$-bench. The primary comparison pairs prewritten task-specific plans (Fixed) with shuffled policy text matched in word count (Sham), isolating the contribution of guidance content. Across 265 matched cells, Fixed improves oracle-verified success by 7.17 percentage points (90\% task-clustered bootstrap interval, 1.15--13.36 points), with gains concentrated in higher-complexity tasks. A read-only terminal verifier rejects 61\% of Retail oracle-invalid episodes while withholding 17\% of correct ones, at less than one cent of additional cost per episode. Which component matters more depends on the loss assigned to erroneous acceptance: at low liability the planning gain dominates; at high liability the verifier's avoided false passes dominate---and a standalone verifier captures nearly all the false-pass benefit of the full planning-plus-verification stack at a fraction of its cost.

中文摘要：智能体框架提供规划指导、组织执行并检查完成情况。本文在τ²-bench的两个零售实验和一个航空试点中研究这些组件如何影响成功率、错误接受与成本。主要比较将预先编写的任务特定计划（Fixed）与词数匹配的打乱策略文本（Sham）配对，以分离指导内容的贡献。在265个匹配单元中，Fixed将oracle验证的成功率提高7.17个百分点（90%任务聚类自助区间1.15–13.36点），增益集中在较高复杂度任务上。只读终端验证器拒绝61%的零售oracle无效片段，同时扣留17%的正确片段，每片段额外成本低于一美分。哪个组件更重要取决于分配给错误接受的损失：在低责任下规划增益占主导；在高责任下验证器避免的假通过占主导——且独立验证器以极低成本捕获了完整规划加验证栈几乎全部的假通过收益。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究表明，在LLM智能体框架中，规划指导内容与验证机制的价值取决于任务复杂度与错误接受的责任成本；独立验证器可在低成本下实现大部分假通过收益，这为设计面向城市更新等高风险决策场景的智能体验证流程提供了参考。

相关度：62/100 该文研究LLM智能体框架中规划信息与发布控制对成功率、错误接受与成本的影响，属于LLM与多智能体方向，与研究者关注的LLM和多智能体主题直接相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: SkillAA: Attribution-Guided Skill-Graph Updating with Targeted Validation and Rollback
item.description:
中文标题：SkillAA：归因引导的技能图更新与定向验证和回滚

作者：Ziqiao Shang, Ling-Yue Ge, Lan-Zhe Guo

Abstract: External skills provide domain procedures without parameter updates, but existing methods often edit skills directly from failed rollouts without structured routing from an observed failure to an editable location; existing skill graphs also underuse semantic boundaries, object addresses, and topological dependencies for skill retrieval, targeted updating, and scoped validation. We introduce SkillAA (Skill Abductive Attribution), a structured skill-optimization framework for frozen language models. It represents skill applicability, execution, and composition in a unified graph, allowing the same structure to support skill selection, attribution-guided repair, and update validation. SkillAA contrasts successful and failed executions to route candidate repairs to specific graph objects, updates only the selected local structure, and uses Local and Big Gates to screen candidate changes before commitment. With gpt-5.6-sol, SkillAA reaches 81.5%, 66.7%, and 91.2% on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA, respectively, and attains the highest observed mean in every main setting. These results support the utility of attribution-guided graph editing and graph-scoped validation.

中文摘要：外部技能无需参数更新即可提供领域流程，但现有方法往往直接从失败轨迹中编辑技能，缺乏从观察到失败到可编辑位置的结构化路由；现有技能图也未充分利用语义边界、对象地址和拓扑依赖进行技能检索、定向更新和范围验证。本文提出SkillAA（技能溯因归因），一种面向冻结语言模型的结构化技能优化框架。它将技能适用性、执行和组合统一表示为图，使同一结构支持技能选择、归因引导修复和更新验证。SkillAA对比成功与失败执行，将候选修复路由到特定图对象，仅更新选定的局部结构，并使用Local和Big Gates在提交前筛选候选变更。使用gpt-5.6-sol时，SkillAA在SearchQA、LiveMath和DocVQA上分别达到81.5%、66.7%和91.2%，并在每个主要设置中取得观测最高均值。这些结果支持归因引导图编辑和图范围验证的效用。

研究启发（模型推断）：该框架将技能选择、修复与验证统一在图结构上，其归因引导与局部更新思路可迁移至城市更新知识库或多智能体协作流程中的技能维护，但摘要未涉及地理空间数据。

相关度：55/100 该文提出面向冻结语言模型的技能优化框架，涉及技能图更新、归因引导修复与验证回滚，属于LLM智能体与多智能体方向，与研究者关注点相关，但无地理空间应用。

作者：Ziqiao Shang, Ling-Yue Ge, Lan-Zhe Guo

Abstract: External skills provide domain procedures without parameter updates, but existing methods often edit skills directly from failed rollouts without structured routing from an observed failure to an editable location; existing skill graphs also underuse semantic boundaries, object addresses, and topological dependencies for skill retrieval, targeted updating, and scoped validation. We introduce SkillAA (Skill Abductive Attribution), a structured skill-optimization framework for frozen language models. It represents skill applicability, execution, and composition in a unified graph, allowing the same structure to support skill selection, attribution-guided repair, and update validation. SkillAA contrasts successful and failed executions to route candidate repairs to specific graph objects, updates only the selected local structure, and uses Local and Big Gates to screen candidate changes before commitment. With gpt-5.6-sol, SkillAA reaches 81.5%, 66.7%, and 91.2% on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA, respectively, and attains the highest observed mean in every main setting. These results support the utility of attribution-guided graph editing and graph-scoped validation.

item.title: The Organization of Inference: Information, Resource Constraints, and AI Production
item.description:
中文标题：推理的组织：信息、资源约束与AI生产

作者：Yukun Zhang, Kemu Xu, Yishen Chen

Abstract: The economic value of inference depends on how capacity and task information are distributed across stages of AI production. We study these organizational margins using controlled workflow experiments on externally verified software-engineering tasks. In two matched resource panels, direct execution records the same success rate of 59.6 percent at logical-token ceilings of 12,000 and 24,000, while success under information-constrained planning rises from 36.2 to 51.2 percent. The planning disadvantage narrows by 15.0 percentage points (95 percent task-cluster bootstrap interval: 4.2 to 25.8). A strict read-only planning campaign varies whether the planner sees the task issue. At 12,000 tokens, issue access raises success by about 16 percentage points over issue-hidden planning. Compared with direct execution, task-informed planning is about 10 points lower at 12,000 tokens; at 24,000 tokens, it shows a 29.6-point advantage. In the resource panels, direct execution uses substantially less than either ceiling, while the planning workflow's binding rate falls from 46.2 to 0.8 percent and downstream execution accounts for 89.9 percent of the increase in total use. Scale determines the capacity available to a system; workflow and information structure shape the productive value

中文摘要：推理的经济价值取决于容量和任务信息如何在AI生产的各阶段分布。本文使用外部验证的软件工程任务上的受控工作流实验研究这些组织边际。在两个匹配资源面板中，直接执行在12,000和24,000逻辑token上限下记录到相同的59.6%成功率，而信息受限规划下的成功率从36.2%升至51.2%。规划劣势缩小15.0个百分点（95%任务聚类自助区间：4.2至25.8）。一项严格的只读规划实验改变规划者是否看到任务问题。在12,000 token时，问题访问使成功率比问题隐藏规划提高约16个百分点。与直接执行相比，任务知情规划在12,000 token时低约10个百分点；在24,000 token时则显示29.6个百分点的优势。在资源面板中，直接执行的使用量远低于任一上限，而规划工作流的绑定率从46.2%降至0.8%，下游执行占总使用增量的89.9%。规模决定系统可用容量；工作流和信息结构塑造生产价值。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究揭示了信息结构与资源约束如何共同决定AI推理的生产价值，其关于规划信息访问与token预算权衡的发现，可为设计城市更新分析中的LLM多智能体工作流提供组织层面的参考。

相关度：58/100 该文研究AI生产中推理能力的组织边际，涉及信息、资源约束与工作流结构，属于LLM智能体与多智能体系统效率方向，与研究者关注点相关，但无地理空间应用。

item.title: Cross-Architecture Foundation-Model Distillation for Edge Flood Segmentation
item.description:
作者：Fabian Schmalstieg, Karsten Mueller, and Wojciech Samek

Abstract: Geospatial foundation models can provide strong flood-segmentation performance, but their size limits deployment on memory-constrained edge hardware. We distill a 300-million-parameter Prithvi-EO-2.0 teacher, fine-tuned on the 252 manually labeled Sen1Floods11 training scenes, into a 0.7-million-parameter EfficientViT-B0 student. The teacher supervises additional unlabeled Sentinel-2 imagery, allowing the student training set to grow without new manual annotations. At the matched budget of 252 scenes, teacher-supervised training is competitive with direct training and improves STURM-Flood performance across tested configurations; a geometry-matched control shows that label source alone does not explain the difference. Scaling the teacher-supervised pool to 2,500 scenes narrows the remaining student--teacher gap: the float student reaches 0.787 water intersection over union on the Sen1Floods11 test split against 0.822 for the teacher, matches the teacher on STURM-Flood under our evaluation protocol, and remains below it on WorldFloods-v2. After activation replacement and quantization-aware training, the student runs as a 1.5-megabyte 8-bit integer (INT8) TensorRT engine on a Jetson Xavier NX at 5.57 milliseconds of graphics processing unit (GPU) compute per 512-by-512 image, with approximately 14 megabytes of runtime device memory. A fixed modified normalized difference water index (MNDWI) threshold is competitive with both models on the two clean external benchmarks, so we interpret those benchmarks as generalization tests rather than as evidence of learned-model superiority over a spectral rule. The results support the conclusion: foundation-model supervision can amplify a fixed manual annotation budget into a substantially larger training set and yield a compact, deployable edge model.

相关度：55/100 关键词命中：Geospatial、Segmentation

item.title: FedeRICo: Federated Region-Influenced Coupling for Traffic Flow Prediction
item.description:
中文标题：FedeRICo：面向交通流预测的联邦区域影响耦合

作者：Fermin Orozco, Man Luo, Johan Wahlstr\"om

Abstract: Urban traffic forecasting often relies on information distributed across stakeholders who may be unable to share raw data due to privacy or commercial constraints, motivating federated spatial-temporal approaches. In such federated settings, each client observes traffic over a distinct sensor subgraph with its own spatial topology and temporal dynamics, leading to significant heterogeneity across clients. Existing federated spatial-temporal methods typically rely on model parameter aggregation and provide limited mechanisms for recovering spatial dependencies across client boundaries. This introduces two key limitations. Specifically, parameter aggregation across heterogeneous graph domains tends to dilute client-specific representations, while road network partitioning breaks the propagation of traffic dynamics across client boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose FedeRICo, a federated traffic forecasting framework that combines gradient-level collaboration with boundary-aware residual communication. FedeRICo employs a dual-branch forecasting architecture in which a globally guided branch captures transferable forecasting structure, while a private residual branch preserves client-specific corrections and incorporates boundary residual signals. The global branch is coordinated through gradient alignment across all clients, enabling collaborative optimisation without destructive parameter interference. To recover cross-client spatial dependencies, boundary messages are extracted through a trend-residual decomposition that suppresses periodic structure and communicates only transient spatial-temporal residual signals between physically adjacent clients. Experiments across four real-world traffic forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that FedeRICo consistently outperforms state-of-the-art federated spatial-temporal baselines while maintaining competitive training runtime.

中文摘要：城市交通预测通常依赖分布在多个利益相关方之间的信息，而这些方可能因隐私或商业约束无法共享原始数据，这推动了联邦时空方法的发展。在此类联邦设定中，每个客户端观测不同传感器子图上的交通，具有自己的空间拓扑和时间动态，导致客户端间显著异质性。现有联邦时空方法通常依赖模型参数聚合，恢复跨客户端边界空间依赖的机制有限。这带来两个关键局限：跨异质图域的参数聚合倾向于稀释客户端特定表示，而路网划分破坏了交通动态跨客户端边界的传播。为应对这些挑战，作者提出FedeRICo，一种联邦交通预测框架，结合梯度级协作与边界感知残差通信。FedeRICo采用双分支预测架构，其中全局引导分支捕获可迁移的预测结构，而私有残差分支保留客户端特定修正并纳入边界残差信号。全局分支通过所有客户端间的梯度对齐进行协调，实现无破坏性参数干扰的协作优化。为恢复跨客户端空间依赖，边界消息通过趋势—残差分解提取，抑制周期性结构并仅在物理相邻客户端之间传递瞬态时空残差信号。在四个真实世界交通预测基准上的实验表明，FedeRICo持续优于……

研究启发（模型推断）：该文指出联邦时空预测中参数聚合会稀释客户端特征且路网划分会切断跨边界传播，并用梯度对齐加边界残差通信来缓解；这对城市多源数据融合和隐私约束下的时空建模具有直接方法学参考价值。

相关度：72/100 该文研究联邦设置下的城市交通流预测，涉及时空数据挖掘、跨客户端空间依赖恢复和隐私约束，与GIS博士研究中的时空数据挖掘和城市分析方向高度相关。

item.title: CitySTAR: Structured and Topology-Aware Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Urban 3D Grounding
item.description:
中文标题：CitySTAR：面向开放词汇城市3D定位的结构化与拓扑感知推理

作者：Shuai Zhang, Hongye Hou, Qinghe Liu, Zhuoxiao Li, Dongli Wu, Jing Ou, Yuan Liu, Wufan Zhao

Abstract: 3D grounding aims to localize target entities in complex scenes from natural language and plays a fundamental role in embodied perception and spatial reasoning. However, existing approaches mostly rely on feature similarity or direct matching, making it difficult to connect natural-language intent with the implicit semantic and geometric structures hidden in billion-scale urban point clouds. We reformulate city-scale 3D grounding as structured constraint reasoning, where description semantics are organized into computable cross-modal constraints over open-vocabulary 3D entities, attributes, and spatial relations. We present CitySTAR, a training-free framework for reasoning-driven urban 3D grounding. CitySTAR lifts raw billion-scale urban point clouds into a query-ready scene graph of open-vocabulary 3D instances, with CodeLLM-driven tools supplying multimodal evidence for node attributes and 3D spatial relations. It then models target-context topology with paired hypergraphs and performs bidirectional topology verification for structural disambiguation. Finally, a Reflective Cross-modal Grounding module integrates topology consistency and candidate-centered 2D visual evidence to make decisions over a metric-aware 3D context graph. To further support this setting, we introduce CitySTAR-3D, an enhanced benchmark that improves semantic coverage, instance completeness, bounding-box fidelity, and spatial-relation complexity in city-scale 3D grounding. Extensive experiments show that CitySTAR consistently improves open-world urban 3D grounding while maintaining strong interpretability and generalization.

中文摘要：该文将城市尺度3D定位重构为结构化约束推理，把描述语义组织为对开放词汇3D实体、属性与空间关系的可计算跨模态约束。CitySTAR将十亿级城市点云提升为可查询的开放词汇场景图，用CodeLLM驱动工具提供节点属性与3D空间关系的多模态证据，并以成对超图建模目标-上下文拓扑、进行双向拓扑验证，最后通过反思式跨模态定位模块结合拓扑一致性与候选中心2D视觉证据在度量感知3D上下文图上决策。作者还提出CitySTAR-3D基准，实验显示其在开放世界城市3D定位上持续提升，并保持较强可解释性与泛化能力。

研究启发（模型推断）：该框架把城市点云中的语义与几何结构显式组织为可推理约束，为城市更新场景中的目标检索与空间关系理解提供了可解释路径，但其在动态城市变化监测中的时效性仍需验证。

相关度：78/100 该文面向城市尺度3D点云的开放词汇定位，提出结构化约束推理与拓扑感知框架，直接涉及城市空间语义、几何结构与多模态推理，与城市更新、时空数据挖掘及地理空间智能高度相关。

item.title: For Your Eyes Only: Evaluating Coordination Between Isolated Language Model Instances
item.description:
中文标题：仅供你眼：评估隔离语言模型实例之间的协调

作者：Alexander Shirnin, Aleksey Kudelya

Abstract: As model-generated content is increasingly consumed by other model instances in automated workflows, a practically important question arises: can a model embed a signal in natural language that an independent instance of the same model can detect, relying only on shared pre-training and task instructions, without any shared memory or coordination-specific training? We introduce For Your Eyes Only, a cooperative signalling game designed to evaluate this directly. A Sender produces free-form descriptions for two words, one of which is a hidden target; an isolated Receiver must identify it. We evaluate seven contemporary models from four architectural families on 300 word pairs from established psycholinguistic corpora, using the Double-Pass Success Rate to control for output biases. We find that most models struggle to maintain coordination once they are required to avoid detectable signals, while one frontier model retains near-perfect performance even after such filtering. We further show that models can direct this capability toward deliberate misdirection, and that coordination is consistently weaker across architectures than within them.

中文摘要：随着模型生成内容在自动化工作流中越来越多地被其他模型实例消费，一个实际重要的问题出现了：模型能否在自然语言中嵌入一种信号，使同一模型的独立实例仅依靠共享预训练和任务指令、而无需共享记忆或专门协调训练即可检测到？作者提出“For Your Eyes Only”合作信号博弈来直接评估这一点。发送者为两个词生成自由形式描述，其中一个是隐藏目标；一个隔离的接收者必须识别它。作者在来自已建立心理语言学语料库的300个词对上评估了来自四个架构家族的七个当代模型，使用双通过成功率来控制输出偏差。研究发现，大多数模型一旦被要求避免可检测信号就难以维持协调，而一个前沿模型即使经过此类过滤仍保持近乎完美的表现。作者进一步表明模型可以将这种能力用于故意误导，并且跨架构的协调始终弱于同一架构内的协调。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示：在LLM驱动的多智能体地理空间工作流中，若需要模型间隐式协作或防泄漏通信，跨架构协调可能不可靠；同时模型可能具备故意误导能力，这对多智能体决策的可信性构成潜在风险。

相关度：62/100 该论文研究隔离语言模型实例之间的协调与信号传递，属于LLM与多智能体交互范畴，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models
item.description:
中文标题：超越界面的安全：通过大语言模型中的潜状态检测危害

作者：Alizishaan Khatri, Chiquita Prabhu, Omkar Neogi

Abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.

中文摘要：自主系统日益依赖大语言模型（LLM），但围绕这些模型的安全基础设施带来延迟和计算开销，限制了在资源受限、时间关键部署中的效用。现有外部护栏模型对模型内部工作机制不可见，造成根本性的保障缺口。作者提问：模型是否已经知道内容有害？他们从LLaMA-3.1-8B提取激活，训练轻量MLP分类器探针（1260万参数）来检测有害提示。在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0上评估，探针分别达到99%、83%和84%的F1分数，与大1000倍的护栏模型相比具有竞争力，同时降低延迟和计算成本。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示：在多智能体地理空间系统中，可利用LLM内部激活的轻量探针实现低延迟安全过滤，减少对外部大护栏模型的依赖；但探针性能在不同数据集上差异明显，跨域泛化仍需验证。

相关度：58/100 该论文研究通过LLM内部潜状态检测有害内容，属于LLM安全与可解释性，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间应用。

item.title: Compositional Reasoning in Language Models under Reinforcement Learning Post-Training
item.description:
中文标题：强化学习后训练下语言模型的组合推理

作者：Yu He, Yingxi Li, Yifei Wang, Ellen Vitercik

Abstract: Compositional reasoning is critical for real-world problem solving: since training data is necessarily limited, models must generalize by composing learned skills in new ways. While post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the reasoning abilities of language models (LMs), their effects on compositional reasoning remain less well understood. We propose a dependency-graph framework to formalize compositional reasoning, yielding three levels of compositionality with increasing complexity. Empirically, we instantiate this framework with data-structure tasks, which provide deterministic reward computation and clear compositional structure. We find a consistent decomposed-to-composed asymmetry: decomposed-skill training does not reliably transfer to composed tasks, whereas composed-task training transfers more readily back to decomposed tasks. We provide theoretical explanation for this asymmetry, and further evaluate compositional generalization under length extrapolation, structural distribution shift, and transfer to tasks requiring unseen skills. Finally, we present a pilot study on real-world tool-calling benchmarks, showing preliminary evidence that the decomposed-to-composed asymmetry can extend to practical settings.

中文摘要：组合推理对现实世界问题求解至关重要：由于训练数据必然有限，模型必须通过以新方式组合已学技能来泛化。尽管强化学习（RL）等后训练方法显著提升了语言模型（LM）的推理能力，但其对组合推理的影响仍不太清楚。作者提出依赖图框架来形式化组合推理，产生三个复杂度递增的组合层级。在实证上，他们用数据结构任务实例化该框架，这些任务提供确定性奖励计算和清晰的组合结构。作者发现一致的“分解到组合”不对称性：分解技能训练不能可靠迁移到组合任务，而组合任务训练更容易迁移回分解任务。作者为该不对称性提供理论解释，并进一步评估长度外推、结构分布偏移以及迁移到需要未见技能任务下的组合泛化。最后，作者在真实工具调用基准上进行初步研究，显示“分解到组合”不对称性可能延伸到实际场景的初步证据。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示：在构建需要多步骤地理空间推理的LLM智能体时，直接训练组合任务可能比分别训练子技能更有效；但该结论来自数据结构任务和初步工具调用实验，迁移到复杂地理空间工作流仍需验证。

相关度：60/100 该论文研究强化学习后训练对语言模型组合推理的影响，属于LLM推理能力研究，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间数据。

item.title: Bayesian Optimization with Rich Auxiliary Information via LLMs
item.description:
中文标题：基于大语言模型的丰富辅助信息贝叶斯优化

作者：Tejus Gupta, Efe Mert Karag\"ozl\"u, Rohit Sonker, Barnab\'as P\'oczos, Jeff Schnieder

Abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions, yet many real-world optimization problems contain substantially richer information than function evaluations alone. Examples include training curves in hyperparameter optimization, expert notes and images in scientific experimentation, and prior knowledge about where optima may lie. We show that large language models (LLMs) can effectively leverage such rich auxiliary information to guide optimization. Motivated by these findings, we develop three methods for incorporating auxiliary information into BO using LLMs. Across hyperparameter optimization benchmarks and a real-world nuclear fusion optimization task, our methods consistently outperform both standard BO and existing LLM-based optimization approaches. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of LLMs for leveraging rich auxiliary information in BO.

中文摘要：贝叶斯优化广泛用于优化昂贵的黑盒函数，但许多现实优化问题包含比函数评估更丰富的信息，例如超参数优化中的训练曲线、科学实验中的专家笔记和图像，以及关于最优解可能位置的先验知识。作者表明大语言模型能够有效利用这些丰富辅助信息来指导优化，并据此提出三种将辅助信息通过LLM融入贝叶斯优化的方法。在超参数优化基准和真实核聚变优化任务上，这些方法持续优于标准贝叶斯优化和现有基于LLM的优化方法。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示LLM可作为融合非结构化辅助信息的优化引导器，其思路或可迁移至地理空间优化问题，但论文本身未涉及地理或城市应用，需谨慎推断。

相关度：62/100 该论文研究利用大语言模型整合丰富辅助信息以指导贝叶斯优化，与研究中LLM与智能体方法相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用，属于方法层面的间接参考。

item.title: Less Is More: Graph-free Multimodal RAG via Multi-signal Late Fusion
item.description:
中文标题：少即是多：基于多信号后期融合的无图多模态RAG

作者：Tithi Rakshit, Hongkuan Zhou, Lavdim Halilaj, Yuqicheng Zhu

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used for multimodal, cross-document question answering. However, building corpus-level graphs is expensive, slow to query, and difficult to maintain. We present TrioRAG, a graph-free multimodal framework that integrates evidence from three complementary signals: the question, the anchor image, and a VLM-enhanced query generated from both. Each signal retrieves independently over a shared multi-vector index of page text and page images, and the results are combined through late fusion. Further, we introduce AutoQA, a multimodal automotive benchmark whose questions are grounded in noisy, web-sourced images rather than clean document-sourced figures. Its questions require reasoning across manuals. We position it as a model-curated testbed rather than a human-validated gold standard. Across three benchmarks, TrioRAG matches or outperforms graph-based systems while reducing total cost and accelerating per-query inference by 1.6-2.3 times. By construction, AutoQA grounds its questions in out-of-corpus web images. In this setting image retrieval reaches only 19.3% document-level recall, while text-derived signals, especially the VLM-enhanced query, keep retrieval robust.

中文标题：少即是多：基于多信号后期融合的无图多模态RAG

作者：Tithi Rakshit, Hongkuan Zhou, Lavdim Halilaj, Yuqicheng Zhu

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used for multimodal, cross-document question answering. However, building corpus-level graphs is expensive, slow to query, and difficult to maintain. We present TrioRAG, a graph-free multimodal framework that integrates evidence from three complementary signals: the question, the anchor image, and a VLM-enhanced query generated from both. Each signal retrieves independently over a shared multi-vector index of page text and page images, and the results are combined through late fusion. Further, we introduce AutoQA, a multimodal automotive benchmark whose questions are grounded in noisy, web-sourced images rather than clean document-sourced figures. Its questions require reasoning across manuals. We position it as a model-curated testbed rather than a human-validated gold standard. Across three benchmarks, TrioRAG matches or outperforms graph-based systems while reducing total cost and accelerating per-query inference by 1.6-2.3 times. By construction, AutoQA grounds its questions in out-of-corpus web images. In this setting image retrieval reaches only 19.3% document-level recall, while text-derived signals, especially the VLM-enhanced query, keep retrieval robust.

item.title: Towards Safer RAG: Only Agents Capable of System 2 Thinking may Access Untrusted Documents
item.description:
中文标题：迈向更安全的RAG：只有具备系统2思维能力的智能体才能访问不受信任的文档

作者：Mehrdad Ghassabi, Audrina Ebrahimi, Sadra Hakim, Hamidreza Baradaran Kashani

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has significantly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs), yet these systems remain vulnerable to knowledge-poisoning attacks, in which misinformation in retrieved documents can influence the model's final outputs. Notably, an LLM may correctly detect that a document contains incorrect information while nevertheless being influenced by it. Prior work has addressed this vulnerability through the Cordon Principle, which prevents models responsible for final answer synthesis from directly accessing raw evidence. Although effective, this strict isolation can introduce substantial computational overhead. In this work, we propose a refined security principle: only agents capable of deliberative System 2 reasoning may access untrusted documents. To evaluate this principle, we introduce novel metrics that quantify the discrepancy between misinformation detection and downstream influence. We then empirically compare state-of-the-art reasoning language models with standard language models across these metrics. Our results show that reasoning-capable models are substantially more robust to corrupted evidence, without requiring the strict isolation imposed by the Cordon Principle. These findings provide empirical support for our refined principle and suggest a more practical foundation for secure RAG system design.

中文摘要：针对RAG系统中的知识污染攻击，提出一项安全原则：只有能够进行深思熟虑的系统2推理的智能体才能访问不受信任的文档。通过新指标量化错误信息检测与下游影响之间的差异，并比较推理语言模型和标准语言模型，发现推理模型对受损证据的鲁棒性显著更高。

研究启发（模型推断）：具备推理能力的语言模型对检索到的错误信息具有更强的鲁棒性，这为设计更安全的RAG系统提供了实证支持，无需采用严格的隔离原则。

相关度：60/100 研究探讨了RAG系统中的知识污染攻击，并提出基于推理能力的访问控制原则，对构建安全可靠的LLM应用有直接指导意义，与地理空间智能中基于RAG的知识问答系统安全设计相关。

item.title: Explaining spatial information flow in short-term traffic forecasting models using a gated graph attention network
item.description:
中文标题：使用门控图注意力网络解释短期交通预测模型中的空间信息流

作者：Yue Li, Shujuan Chen, Ying Jin

Abstract: Short-term traffic forecasting supports real-time monitoring and control of road networks, and graph attention networks (GAT) are the standard means of representing spatial dependence in these models. GAT layers are widely described as capturing the influence of neighbouring locations, but this is seldom verified, because the attention weights offered in support cannot be compared against any measured quantity. That leaves two questions open, how the model should be explained and which of its components are necessary. We address this by adding a gate to the GAT layer which learns, at every sensor and every time step, what share of a sensor's updated state is drawn from its neighbours rather than from itself. Regularising the gate withdraws neighbour information progressively and thereby provides a graded form of ablation. We apply the gated GAT to ST-MetaNet, whose encoder and decoder each place one GAT layer between two recurrent layers, and train it on one calendar year of records from 498 loop detectors on the strategic road network of England. The gate assigns a larger share of neighbour information to sensors carrying heavier traffic and follows the daily and weekly cycle of travel, consistent with adjacent locations being more strongly coupled when busy. Mild regularisation improves accuracy slightly, and accuracy declines at higher strengths as the penalty withdraws information the model needs. The encoder gate closes before the decoder gate, but direct ablation qualifies that ordering. Removing either GAT layer alone leaves accuracy at least as good as keeping both, whereas removing both degrades it substantially, so the two layers are largely redundant rather than either being indispensable. The gated GAT therefore yields a modest accuracy gain, an explanation of where and when spatial information flows, and evidence on which layers the architecture requires.

中文摘要：短期交通预测支持路网的实时监测和控制，图注意力网络（GAT）是这些模型中表示空间依赖的标准手段。GAT层被广泛描述为捕捉邻近位置的影响，但这很少被验证，因为支持中提供的注意力权重无法与任何测量量进行比较。这留下了两个未决问题：模型应如何解释，以及其哪些组件是必要的。作者通过向GAT层添加一个门来解决这个问题，该门在每个传感器和每个时间步学习传感器更新状态中有多少份额来自邻居而非自身。对门进行正则化会逐步撤回邻居信息，从而提供一种分级形式的消融。作者将门控GAT应用于ST-MetaNet，其编码器和解码器各在两个循环层之间放置一个GAT层，并在英格兰战略路网498个环形检测器的一个日历年记录上训练。门将更大份额的邻居信息分配给承载更重交通的传感器，并遵循旅行的日周期和周周期，与相邻位置在繁忙时耦合更强一致。轻度正则化略微提高精度，而更高强度下精度下降，因为惩罚撤回了模型所需的信息。编码器门先于解码器门关闭，但直接消融对这一顺序提出了限定。单独移除任一GAT层都能使精度至少与保留两者一样好，而移除两者则显著降低精度，因此这两层在很大程度上是冗余的，而非任一不可或缺。因此，门控GAT产生了适度的精度提升、一种解释……

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究对时空数据挖掘和地理空间智能有直接参考价值，尤其是门控机制用于解释空间信息流的方法，可借鉴于城市更新中的交通与空间交互分析。

相关度：55/100 该论文研究短期交通预测模型中的空间信息流解释，使用门控图注意力网络，属于时空数据挖掘与地理空间智能范畴，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘研究方向有较强关联。

item.title: EviRec: Continual Evidence Learning for Dual Cold-Start POI Recommendation
item.description:
中文标题：EviRec：面向双重冷启动POI推荐的持续证据学习

作者：Rongchao Xu, Lin Jiang, Guang Wang

Abstract: Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation is a core task in location-based services, yet most existing methods assume a fixed user population and POI catalog. Through a large-scale data-driven analysis of 10 U.S. cities, we identify substantial POI churn, user turnover, category drift, and decay in static POI memory, motivating the study of continual dual cold-start POI recommendation. To address this setting, we propose EviRec, a continual evidence-learning framework that estimates how much historical evidence should be trusted separately for each candidate POI. EviRec scores each visible candidate from three complementary views: a matching view based on the user's recent mobility profile, a transition-memory view that captures repeated mobility routines, and a lifecycle view that reflects candidate maturity. Because a near-zero transition score may indicate either irrelevance or insufficient observation, EviRec qualifies the evidence using each candidate's observation state and applies a reliability gate to adaptively route between transition-memory and lifecycle evidence. We evaluate EviRec on a full-year, five-city POI check-in dataset containing more than 30,000 users and 684,200 trajectories. Experimental results show that EviRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with the largest gains concentrated on cold-start queries. In particular, EviRec improves NDCG@10 by 20.4\% on Dual-New cases over the strongest baseline. In-depth analyses further confirm that these gains arise primarily from candidate-specific reliability gating while largely preserving previously learned mobility routines.

中文摘要：兴趣点（POI）推荐是基于位置服务的核心任务，但大多数现有方法假设用户群体和POI目录固定。通过对美国10个城市的大规模数据驱动分析，作者识别出显著的POI流失、用户更替、类别漂移以及静态POI记忆的衰减，从而推动了对持续双重冷启动POI推荐的研究。为解决这一场景，作者提出EviRec，一种持续证据学习框架，分别针对每个候选POI估计应信任多少历史证据。EviRec从三个互补视角对每个可见候选进行评分：基于用户近期移动画像的匹配视角、捕捉重复移动路线的转移记忆视角，以及反映候选成熟度的生命周期视角。由于接近零的转移分数可能表示不相关或观察不足，EviRec利用每个候选的观察状态对证据进行限定，并应用可靠性门控在转移记忆和生命周期证据之间自适应路由。作者在包含超过30,000名用户和684,200条轨迹的全年度五城市POI签到数据集上评估EviRec。实验结果表明，EviRec持续优于最先进的基线，最大增益集中在冷启动查询上。特别是，EviRec在双重新案例上将NDCG@10比最强基线提高了20.4%。深入分析进一步证实，这些增益主要来自候选特定的可靠性门控，同时基本保留了先前学习的移动路线。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究对时空数据挖掘和城市分析有直接参考价值，尤其是持续学习与冷启动处理框架，可借鉴于城市更新中的动态POI变化与用户行为分析。

相关度：60/100 该论文研究兴趣点（POI）推荐中的双重冷启动问题，涉及时空数据挖掘与城市分析，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘研究方向有较强关联。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究对时空数据挖掘和城市分析有直接参考价值，尤其是持续学习与冷启动处理框架，可借鉴于城市更新中的动态POI变化与用户行为分析。

相关度：60/100 该论文研究兴趣点（POI）推荐中的双重冷启动问题，涉及时空数据挖掘与城市分析，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘研究方向有较强关联。

item.title: ZeroHAT: Behavior-Conditioned Zero-Shot Human Activity Trace Generation
item.description:
中文标题：ZeroHAT：行为条件化的零样本人类活动轨迹生成

作者：Rongchao Xu, Dahai Yu, Lin Jiang, Guang Wang

Abstract: Human activity traces record individuals' timestamped visits to points of interest and are essential for applications such as mobility prediction and urban simulation. However, accessing large-scale HATs is challenging due to high collection costs and privacy concerns. Synthetic HAT generation offers a promising way to make such data available and has attracted growing interest from both industry and academia. Although many efforts have been devoted to this topic, most of them rely on real data from a region to generate synthetic data for the same region, which is infeasible for the many regions where real HATs are unavailable. To fill this gap, we propose ZeroHAT, a behavior-conditioned framework that generates synthetic HATs for a target region in a zero-shot manner by transferring behavioral patterns learned from real HATs in source regions and adapting them with publicly available contextual information about the target region. ZeroHAT has three key novel components: (i) a multidimensional consistency-aware intent extractor; (ii) a cross-region behavioral cloning module; and (iii) a behavior-conditioned activity realization module. We evaluate ZeroHAT on a ten-city benchmark, where extensive experiments show that ZeroHAT achieves 4.5-6.4x the normalized downstream utility of the strongest baseline and improves average fidelity by 15.6%-40.8% across target regions.

中文摘要：人类活动轨迹记录个体对兴趣点的带时间戳访问，对移动预测和城市模拟等应用至关重要。然而，由于高收集成本和隐私问题，获取大规模HAT具有挑战性。合成HAT生成提供了一种使此类数据可用的有前景方式，并引起了产业界和学术界的日益关注。尽管已有许多努力，但大多数依赖来自某一区域的真实数据来生成同一区域的合成数据，这对于许多无法获得真实HAT的区域是不可行的。为填补这一空白，作者提出ZeroHAT，一种行为条件化框架，通过迁移从源区域真实HAT中学到的行为模式，并利用目标区域的公开上下文信息进行适应，以零样本方式为目标区域生成合成HAT。ZeroHAT有三个关键新颖组件：（i）多维一致性感知意图提取器；（ii）跨区域行为克隆模块；（iii）行为条件化活动实现模块。作者在十城市基准上评估ZeroHAT，广泛实验表明ZeroHAT实现了最强基线4.5-6.4倍的归一化下游效用，并在目标区域将平均保真度提高了15.6%-40.8%。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究对城市更新和时空数据挖掘有直接参考价值，尤其是零样本跨区域轨迹生成方法，可借鉴于数据稀缺城市的活动模拟与城市更新影响评估。

相关度：70/100 该论文研究零样本人类活动轨迹生成，涉及城市模拟与跨区域行为迁移，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘研究方向高度相关。

item.title: When Does Retrieval Help Time-Series Forecasting?
item.description:
中文标题：检索何时有助于时间序列预测？

作者：Mert Onur Cakiroglu, Elham Buxton, Mehmet Dalkilic, Hasan Kurban

Abstract: Retrieval plug-ins supply a deep forecaster with information its lookback window cannot carry. Published evaluations report consistent gains, and each credits its own mechanism. We show that the benefit belongs instead to the operating point: the relation between window length $S$ and dominant seasonal period $L$, an axis the standard protocol never varies. Stratifying the evaluation by that relation exposes the regime. At $S{=}12$, a simple control that repeats the last observed period beats the six standard backbones, in aggregate, on four of seven benchmarks by $8\%$ to $44\%$ of MSE. It beats the strongest plug-in we run on ETTm1 and matches it on ECL. It is worse by up to $25\%$ on the three datasets whose training-split spectra lack a concentrated, shared period. A controlled synthetic sweep of horizon, period, and window shows the benefit boundary tracks the period (correlation $+0.71$), not the horizon ($-0.23$). A paired control with no phase to recover nearly erases the effect, consistent with phase starvation. Zero-shot pretraining does not escape it: a foundation model trails trained backbones by $22\%$ to $50\%$ on the periodic benchmarks. Within our instrument, exact lookup matches graph diffusion: the payoff is consulting the record, not the machinery on top. Two interpretable statistics, a trend test and a staleness rate, predict the sign of the per-cell benefit at $0.76$ accuracy under leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, a suggestive margin over the $0.69$ majority rule, where a 22-feature stack manages $0.57$. We propose no new plug-in. The contribution is the regime map, the protocol that reveals it, and two statistics that screen it before deployment. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/retrieval-regime.

中文摘要：检索插件为深度预测器提供回看窗口无法承载的信息。已发表评估报告一致增益，且各自归因于自身机制。作者表明，增益实际属于运行点：窗口长度 S 与主导季节周期 L 之间的关系，而标准协议从不改变这一维度。按该关系分层评估可揭示适用区间。在 S=12 时，一个重复最后观测周期的简单对照在七个基准中的四个上，总体以 MSE 的 8% 至 44% 优于六个标准骨干模型；在 ETTm1 上优于所运行的最强插件，在 ECL 上与之持平；在训练集频谱缺乏集中共享周期的三个数据集上则最多差 25%。对预测步长、周期和窗口的受控合成扫描显示，增益边界跟随周期（相关性 +0.71），而非步长（-0.23）。一个无可恢复相位的配对对照几乎消除该效应，与相位饥饿一致。零样本预训练无法规避：基础模型在周期性基准上落后训练骨干 22% 至 50%。在其测量框架内，精确查表与图扩散相当：收益来自查阅记录，而非其上机制。两个可解释统计量——趋势检验与陈旧率——在留一数据集评估下以 0.76 准确率预测逐单元增益符号，略高于 0.69 的多数规则，而 22 特征堆叠仅达 0.57。作者不提出新插件，贡献在于区间图、揭示该区间的协议，以及部署前筛选的两个统计量。代码见 https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/retrieval-regime。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示，在时空预测中引入检索或外部记忆时，增益可能高度依赖窗口长度与主导周期的匹配关系，而非模型复杂度；在城市活动等具有强周期性的时空数据上，部署前可用趋势与陈旧率等简单统计量筛查检索是否值得启用。

相关度：62/100 该文研究检索插件对时间序列预测的增益边界，属于时空数据挖掘与预测方法评估范畴，与研究方向中的时空数据挖掘相关，但不涉及城市更新、遥感或LLM多智能体。

item.title: Scene-Q: Confidence-Aware Coarse-to-Fine Querying of 3D Scenes with Selective VLM Reasoning
item.description:
中文标题：Scene-Q：面向3D场景的置信度感知由粗到细查询与选择性VLM推理

作者：Juno Kim, Yesol Park, Hye-Jung Yoon, Byoung-Tak Zhang

Abstract: Indoor mobile robots require open-vocabulary scene understanding that grounds natural-language queries in a consistent 3D map. Many existing systems ultimately rely on cosine-similarity retrieval with contrastive image--text encoders, which is efficient but brittle when labels are near-synonymous or multiple similar instances appear. We present Scene-Q, a confidence-aware coarse-to-fine querying framework that normalizes encoder scores with temperature scaling and selectively invokes a reasoning VLM only for low-confidence cases. High-confidence queries are answered by fast retrieval, while ambiguous ones are reranked over a small top-K candidate set using the original multi-view images and instance bounding boxes, enabling context-aware disambiguation at low cost. Scene-Q improves open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation on ScanNet200 and natural-language 3D instance retrieval on real-world reconstructions, with the largest gains on spatial and relational queries while keeping a substantial fraction of queries on the fast path.

中文摘要：室内移动机器人需要开放词汇的场景理解，将自然语言查询定位到一致的3D地图中。许多现有系统最终依赖对比图像-文本编码器的余弦相似度检索，这虽然高效，但在标签近义或多个相似实例出现时较为脆弱。作者提出Scene-Q，一种置信度感知的由粗到细查询框架，通过温度缩放归一化编码器分数，并仅对低置信度情况选择性调用推理VLM。高置信度查询由快速检索回答，模糊查询则使用原始多视图图像和实例边界框在小型top-K候选集上重排序，从而以低成本实现上下文感知消歧。Scene-Q在ScanNet200上改进了开放词汇3D实例分割，并在真实世界重建上改进了自然语言3D实例检索，在空间与关系查询上增益最大，同时使相当一部分查询保持在快速路径上。

研究启发（模型推断）：置信度感知的由粗到细检索与选择性调用大模型推理的策略，可迁移到遥感或城市三维场景的开放词汇查询中，用于在效率与消歧之间取得平衡；但该文场景为室内机器人，未涉及地理尺度或变化检测。

相关度：55/100 该文研究室内机器人3D场景的开放词汇查询与选择性VLM推理，涉及3D空间理解与多模态推理，与地理空间智能和遥感变化检测有方法层面的间接关联，但不涉及城市或遥感数据。

item.title: Scene-Conditioned Relation Routing for urban cellular activity forecasting
item.description:
中文标题：面向城市蜂窝活动预测的场景条件关系路由

作者：Qingzhong Li, Jingye Lin, Hui Ma, Yajun Zhang, Xinjun Pei, Ming Yan, and Fei Xing

Abstract: Urban cellular activity forecasting requires jointly modeling heterogeneous spatiotemporal signals, including SMS usage, mobile network traffic, and call activity. Existing methods often separate temporal modeling, spatial relation learning, and multi-signal prediction, relying on fixed graph structures or static multi-task learning schemes, which limits their adaptability to changing urban scenes. We propose SCRR-Net, a scene-conditioned spatial relation routing framework in which urban contextual information jointly controls spatial dependency selection and cross-task knowledge transfer. SCRR-Net includes a context encoder, a spatial graph expert routing module, a temporal Transformer encoder, and a task knowledge routing module. Experiments on the Milano and Trento datasets demonstrate that SCRR-Net consistently outperforms competing methods on SMS, network traffic, and call activity forecasting, while providing interpretable routing behaviors.

item.title: JointMatch: A Unified Heterogeneous Graph Neural Solver for Large-Scale Ride-Sharing Matching
item.description:
中文标题：JointMatch：面向大规模拼车匹配的统一异构图神经求解器

作者：Kun Zhao, Xu Chen

Abstract: Ride-sharing platforms must continuously decide which open requests to bundle into shared trips and which idle vehicles should serve them. The dominant academic approach decomposes this into two sequential matching problems -- request pairing first, then vehicle assignment -- and applies a separate solver to each. This decomposition is convenient computationally but loses revenue and scales poorly because the first stage commits to ride bundles before the available vehicles are known. We propose JointMatch, a learning-based framework that handles request pairing and vehicle assignment together on a single graph. The graph is sparsified by spatial proximity so that its size grows linearly rather than quadratically with the number of vehicles and requests, and a graph neural network scores all candidate decisions in one forward pass. On the New York City Yellow Taxi data, the framework already exceeds both the classical Blossom heuristic and a faithfully-trained two-stage GNN baseline -- often by a wide margin -- and at city scale (fleet 10000) it runs more than $20\times$ faster per dispatch epoch than either. A supervised training stage closes most of the remaining revenue gap, and a policy-gradient fine-tune aligns the trained model with realised revenue.

中文摘要：拼车平台必须持续决定哪些开放请求可捆绑为共享行程，以及哪些空闲车辆应服务这些请求。主流学术方法将其分解为两个顺序匹配问题——先请求配对，再车辆分配——并对每个问题应用单独求解器。这种分解在计算上方便，但会损失收入且扩展性差，因为第一阶段在可用车辆未知时就已确定行程捆绑。作者提出JointMatch，一种基于学习的框架，在单一图上同时处理请求配对与车辆分配。该图通过空间邻近性稀疏化，使其规模随车辆和请求数量线性而非二次增长，图神经网络在一次前向传播中为所有候选决策打分。在纽约市黄色出租车数据上，该框架已超过经典Blossom启发式和忠实训练的两阶段GNN基线——往往优势明显——在城市规模（车队10000）下，每个调度轮次运行速度比二者快20倍以上。监督训练阶段缩小了大部分剩余收入差距，策略梯度微调使训练模型与实现收入对齐。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文展示将空间邻近稀疏化与图神经网络结合，可在城市规模组合优化中同时提升收入与计算效率；其统一图建模与端到端学习思路，对城市更新中的设施选址、资源调度等空间优化问题具有方法借鉴意义。

相关度：72/100 该文研究大规模拼车匹配的异构图神经求解器，属于城市交通与时空优化问题，与城市时空数据挖掘和地理空间智能相关，但不涉及城市更新或遥感。

item.title: Towards Proactive Detection of User-Side Implicit Conflicts in Human-LLM Dialogue
item.description:
中文标题：迈向主动检测人-LLM对话中的用户侧隐式冲突

作者：Jinqiang Wang, Tao Zhu, Huansheng Ning

Abstract: In Human-LLM dialogue, follow-up user utterances may implicitly conflict with earlier intents, leading the LLM to misinterpret user needs and generate inappropriate responses. A reliable dialogue system should proactively detect user-side conflicts before generating a response and seek clarification when necessary. However, prior work has largely focused on LLM-side conflicts, leaving user-side conflicts underexplored. To fill this gap, we construct UC-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating user-side conflict detection. Preliminary experiments show that existing LLMs struggle with this task, especially when conflicts arise from implicit incompatibilities grounded in dialogue history. To improve lightweight LLMs with limited training data, we investigate data synthesis for user-side conflict detection. Existing synthesis methods do not explicitly model the implicit incompatibilities between historical and current user utterances, making it difficult to capture the evolution of conflicts and to generate reliably labeled implicit conflict samples. We propose SynUC, a constraint-guided synthesis method that represents user-side conflicts in a constraint space and uses the SPEAKING framework to guide traceable constraint transformations. Applying SynUC to WildChat, we construct UC-Data, a user-side conflict training set containing 2,487 samples. On UC-Bench, Qwen3.5-4B trained on UC-Data outperforms larger general-purpose LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.8, as well as the same backbone trained on data synthesized by existing methods.

中文摘要：在人-LLM对话中，后续用户话语可能与先前意图隐式冲突，导致LLM误解用户需求并生成不当回应。可靠的对话系统应在生成回应前主动检测用户侧冲突并在必要时寻求澄清。然而，已有工作多聚焦于LLM侧冲突，用户侧冲突研究不足。为填补这一空白，作者构建了UC-Bench，一个经人工标注的基准，用于评估用户侧冲突检测。初步实验表明，现有LLM在该任务上表现不佳，尤其当冲突源于对话历史中的隐式不兼容时。为在有限训练数据下改进轻量级LLM，作者研究了面向用户侧冲突检测的数据合成。现有合成方法未显式建模历史与当前用户话语之间的隐式不兼容，难以捕捉冲突演化并生成可靠标注的隐式冲突样本。作者提出SynUC，一种约束引导的合成方法，将用户侧冲突表示在约束空间中，并使用SPEAKING框架引导可追溯的约束变换。将SynUC应用于WildChat，作者构建了UC-Data，一个包含2,487个样本的用户侧冲突训练集。在UC-Bench上，使用UC-Data训练的Qwen3.5-4B优于Claude Opus 4.8等更大的通用LLM，也优于在现有方法合成数据上训练的同一骨干模型。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示：在构建面向城市更新等领域的LLM对话助手时，用户意图可能随对话推进而隐式漂移，主动冲突检测与澄清机制值得纳入系统设计；其约束空间建模思路或可迁移到地理空间任务约束（如时空范围、分析目标）的一致性校验。

相关度：72/100 该文研究人-LLM对话中用户侧隐式冲突的主动检测，构建UC-Bench基准并提出约束引导的数据合成方法SynUC，与研究中LLM与多智能体方向直接相关，可用于对话式地理空间智能体中的意图一致性维护。

item.title: Infinite-Parameter LLMs: Generating and Adapting Weights from Live Data
item.description:
中文标题：无限参数LLM：从实时数据生成与适配权重

作者：Jinli Hu, Ross M. Clarke, Yichuan Zhang, Jos\'e Miguel Hern\'andez-Lobato

Abstract: The scaling laws hold that a language model grows more capable with more parameters and more training data, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have ridden these laws to remarkable results, activating only a fraction of an enormous stored parameter bank for each token. That success is built on static pretraining data. A deployed model faces a different world, where much of the data that would make it more useful is not in its training set but in the live interaction it is currently handling, such as the facts a user supplies or the corrections they give. A conventional model cannot learn from this data, because its weights are frozen after training. Instead, the knowledge and behaviour supplied at run time are placed in the prompt, by retrieval or instruction, and re-read on every request only to be discarded once the request ends. We ask how an architecture could learn from live interaction by writing it into its weights. Taking inspiration from MoE, we propose the ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：缩放定律认为语言模型随参数和数据增加而更强，MoE架构借此取得显著成果，但成功建立在静态预训练数据之上。部署模型面对的世界不同：许多有用数据不在训练集中，而在当前处理的实时交互中，如用户提供的事实或纠正。传统模型无法从这些数据学习，因为训练后权重冻结，运行时知识只能放入提示中，通过检索或指令，每次请求重新读取后丢弃。作者提问：架构如何通过将实时交互写入权重来从中学习。受MoE启发，提出……（摘要截断）。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作指向LLM从静态预训练向运行时持续学习权重的架构转变，若与地理空间智能结合，可能支持模型在部署中吸收实时城市数据，但摘要未给出具体方法或实验结论。

相关度：62/100 该论文探讨LLM如何从实时交互数据中学习并写入权重，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: WaveTLM: Reliable Time-Series Language Modeling through Task Compilation
item.description:
中文标题：WaveTLM：通过任务编译实现可靠的时间序列语言建模

作者：Jiahui Chen, Bingke Zhu, Hongyu Pan, Yingying Chen

Abstract: Time-series language models provide a shared natural-language interface across temporal tasks, but plausible text does not guarantee reliable task outputs. Responses may appear reasonable while hallucinating the required object: numerical sequences can violate shape, scale, channel order, or temporal alignment, and textual decisions can fall outside the legal label space. We formulate reliable time-series language modeling, separating task-object reliability from predictive quality. We introduce ExecTS-QA, a contract-grounded benchmark spanning forecasting, imputation, classification, anomaly detection, and waveform analysis. We further propose WaveTLM, a unified compiler-executor model whose task compiler transforms user requests, visible arguments, and wave-grounded evidence into typed task states, while task-native executors construct numerical tensors, legal decisions, or structured records. On ExecTS-QA, a single WaveTLM checkpoint achieves 99.40% contract-valid coverage, compared with 37.83% for the strongest evaluated string-first baseline, while retaining balanced predictive performance across all five task families. Evaluations on SciTS, TSQA, IRTS-ToolBench, and ARFBench provide additional evidence of transfer. The code, construction scripts, and ExecTS-QA dataset will be publicly released upon publication. These results show that task compilation can convert plausible language generation into reliable time-series outputs.

中文摘要：时间序列语言模型为跨时间任务提供共享自然语言接口，但看似合理的文本不保证可靠任务输出。响应可能看似合理却幻觉所需对象：数值序列可能违反形状、尺度、通道顺序或时间对齐，文本决策可能超出合法标签空间。作者提出可靠时间序列语言建模，将任务对象可靠性与预测质量分离。引入ExecTS-QA，一个契约基础的基准，涵盖预测、插补、分类、异常检测和波形分析。进一步提出WaveTLM，一个统一编译器-执行器模型，其任务编译器将用户请求、可见参数和波形基础证据转换为类型化任务状态，而任务原生执行器构建数值张量、合法决策或结构化记录。在ExecTS-QA上，单个WaveTLM检查点达到99.40%契约有效覆盖率，而最强评估的字符串优先基线为37.83%，同时在五个任务族中保持平衡预测性能。在SciTS、TSQA、IRTS-ToolBench和ARFBench上的评估提供额外迁移证据。代码、构建脚本和ExecTS-QA数据集将在发表后公开。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作通过任务编译将语言生成转化为可靠时间序列输出，对时空数据挖掘中时间序列预测的可靠性有参考价值，但摘要未涉及地理空间数据或城市更新应用。

相关度：55/100 该论文提出时间序列语言模型的可靠任务编译框架，与时空数据挖掘中的时间序列建模相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新。

item.title: CERA-MoA: Co-Evolving Routing Mechanisms with Continually Learning LLM Agents
item.description:
中文标题：CERA-MoA：路由机制与持续学习LLM智能体的协同进化

作者：Jiaxuan Jiang, Liyuan He, Zhixuan Fang

Abstract: Current Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) paradigms generally treat query routing and agent fine-tuning as separate processes, limiting their ability to respond to evolving agent capabilities. This disconnect prevents routing strategies from adapting to evolving agent capabilities during post-training and prevents agents from achieving synergistic data-driven specialization. To resolve this, we introduce CERA-MoA (Co-Evolving Router with continually learning Agents for Mixture-of-Agents), an iterative reinforcement learning framework where the dynamic router and independent agent policies co-evolve. We design a predictive familiarity estimator that leverages mid-layer hidden states to evaluate semantic competence among agents, avoiding the overhead of full rollouts. Based on these familiarity scores, a cumulative-threshold adaptive routing mechanism dynamically activates a tailored minimal agent subset, achieving a trade-off between task performance and efficiency. By proactively allocating targeted training samples to agents based on their evolving competence, CERA-MoA promotes capability differentiation. Extensive experiments across various domains demonstrate that CERA-MoA outperforms state-of-the-art static-agent routing and fix-workflow fine-tuning baselines.

中文摘要：当前混合智能体（MoA）范式通常将查询路由和智能体微调视为独立过程，限制了其响应智能体能力演变的能力。这种脱节使路由策略无法在训练后适应智能体能力演变，也阻止智能体实现协同的数据驱动专业化。为解决此问题，作者引入CERA-MoA（Co-Evolving Router with continually learning Agents for Mixture-of-Agents），一个迭代强化学习框架，其中动态路由器和独立智能体策略协同进化。设计预测性熟悉度估计器，利用中间层隐藏状态评估智能体间的语义能力，避免完整rollout的开销。基于这些熟悉度分数，累积阈值自适应路由机制动态激活定制的最小智能体子集，实现任务性能与效率的权衡。通过根据智能体演变能力主动分配针对性训练样本，CERA-MoA促进能力分化。跨领域广泛实验表明，CERA-MoA优于最先进的静态智能体路由和固定工作流微调基线。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作为多智能体系统的动态路由与持续学习提供协同进化框架，若应用于城市更新中的多智能体协作，可能提升任务分配与能力专业化，但摘要未涉及地理空间场景。

相关度：60/100 该论文提出路由与智能体持续学习协同进化的MoA框架，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向高度相关，但未涉及地理空间应用。

item.title: Recursive Reasoning or Statistical Extrapolation? In-Context Learning in Multi-Agent Interdependent Decision-Making
item.description:
中文标题：递归推理还是统计外推？多智能体相互依赖决策中的上下文学习

作者：Yu Liu, Wenwen Li, Yifan Dou, Guangnan Ye

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve decisions using interaction history, yet it remains unclear whether such improvement reflects refined internal reasoning or mere extrapolation of statistical patterns. To disentangle these mechanisms, we study LLM agents in multi-agent incomplete-information games that require recursive belief reasoning. By constructing a public goods game and manipulating the statistical structure of historical feedback, we evaluate decision quality against a history-independent rational expectations equilibrium (REE) benchmark. Our experiments reveal that when historical statistical patterns are disrupted, the benefits of longer context largely vanish, degrading decision quality to the no-context baseline in a way sharply amplified by stronger strategic interdependence. These results suggest that, in such strategic environments, ICL behavior is more consistent with statistical extrapolation than with strategic reasoning. Our work extends the mechanistic study of ICL to strategic multi-agent settings, introduces REE as a diagnostic tool for distinguishing reasoning from extrapolation, and provides a reusable framework for probing the boundaries of LLM reasoning in recursive belief tasks.

中文摘要：上下文学习使大语言模型智能体能够利用交互历史改进决策，但这种改进究竟反映内部推理的精细化，还是仅仅是对统计模式的外推，仍不清楚。为区分这两种机制，作者研究需要递归信念推理的多智能体不完全信息博弈中的LLM智能体。通过构建公共品博弈并操纵历史反馈的统计结构，作者以历史无关的理性预期均衡为基准评估决策质量。实验显示，当历史统计模式被破坏时，更长上下文带来的收益基本消失，决策质量退化到无上下文基线，且这种退化在更强策略相互依赖下被显著放大。这些结果表明，在此类策略环境中，ICL行为更符合统计外推而非策略推理。该工作将ICL的机制研究扩展到策略性多智能体场景，引入REE作为区分推理与外推的诊断工具，并提供可复用框架以探测LLM在递归信念任务中的推理边界。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，LLM智能体在多智能体策略环境中的上下文学习可能主要依赖历史统计规律而非递归推理；这对将LLM和多智能体用于城市更新决策模拟时评估其策略可靠性具有警示意义。

相关度：55/100 该文研究LLM智能体在多智能体不完全信息博弈中的上下文学习机制，区分递归推理与统计外推，与用户研究画像中的LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市更新数据。
item.content:encoded:
中文标题：递归推理还是统计外推？多智能体相互依赖决策中的上下文学习

作者：Yu Liu, Wenwen Li, Yifan Dou, Guangnan Ye

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve decisions using interaction history, yet it remains unclear whether such improvement reflects refined internal reasoning or mere extrapolation of statistical patterns. To disentangle these mechanisms, we study LLM agents in multi-agent incomplete-information games that require recursive belief reasoning. By constructing a public goods game and manipulating the statistical structure of historical feedback, we evaluate decision quality against a history-independent rational expectations equilibrium (REE) benchmark. Our experiments reveal that when historical statistical patterns are disrupted, the benefits of longer context largely vanish, degrading decision quality to the no-context baseline in a way sharply amplified by stronger strategic interdependence. These results suggest that, in such strategic environments, ICL behavior is more consistent with statistical extrapolation than with strategic reasoning. Our work extends the mechanistic study of ICL to strategic multi-agent settings, introduces REE as a diagnostic tool for distinguishing reasoning from extrapolation, and provides a reusable framework for probing the boundaries of LLM reasoning in recursive belief tasks.

item.title: Interpretable Patch-Based Deep Learning for Wildfire Spread Prediction from Ensemble Simulations
item.description:
中文标题：基于集成模拟的可解释分块深度学习野火蔓延预测

作者：Marcin Lawenda, Aleksandra Krasicka, David Caballero, Luis Torres, {\L}ukasz Szustak

Abstract: Wildfire spread is traditionally predicted using physics-based simulators, which are physically interpretable but whose cost increases with each additional ensemble member. We ask how well deep learning surrogates can reproduce these simulations at a fraction of this cost, training them on 10,584 fire spread simulations at 2m resolution for the Rectoret region in Catalonia, Spain. Four architectures are compared: a patch-based U-Net, a transfer-learned ResNet-50, a physics-informed network constrained by the wind-driven advection equation and a Swin-Unet transformer. Among the terrain and vegetation variables, only surface fuel load predicts burn probability with any strength (r = 0.27) and including it lowers prediction error by 21%. The remaining variables correlate weakly and are highly duplicative. Next, an experiment with saliency, occlusion and rotation demonstrates the models' learning. Convolutional models rely primarily on distance from the current fire front, while Swin-Unet assigns more weight to fuel and terrain, a finding also noted in an unrelated wildfire dataset. When applied without retraining to the second region, Pedriza, all three convolutional models still predict fire spread, losing accuracy by a small but systematic margin.

中文摘要：野火蔓延传统上使用基于物理的模拟器预测，这类方法物理可解释，但每增加一个集成成员成本就上升。本文探讨深度学习代理模型能否以一小部分成本复现这些模拟，并在西班牙加泰罗尼亚Rectoret地区2米分辨率的10,584次火蔓延模拟上训练。比较了四种架构：分块U-Net、迁移学习ResNet-50、受风驱动平流方程约束的物理信息网络和Swin-Unet Transformer。在地形和植被变量中，只有地表可燃物载量对燃烧概率具有较强预测能力（r=0.27），纳入该变量使预测误差降低21%；其余变量相关性弱且高度重复。随后通过显著性、遮挡和旋转实验展示模型学习情况。卷积模型主要依赖与当前火线的距离，而Swin-Unet更重视燃料和地形，这一发现在另一个无关野火数据集中也有体现。在不重新训练的情况下应用于第二区域Pedriza时，三个卷积模型仍能预测火蔓延，但精度以小幅但系统性的幅度下降。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究表明深度学习代理模型可在低成本下近似物理野火模拟，且不同架构依赖的环境线索存在差异；其跨区域精度系统性下降提示，将此类代理模型迁移到城市周边或不同地理区域时需谨慎评估域偏移。

相关度：68/100 该文利用深度学习代理模型从集成模拟中预测野火蔓延，涉及地形、植被等遥感环境变量、可解释性分析和跨区域迁移，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合及地理空间智能中的环境建模相关。

item.title: SVMemAgent: A Streaming Video Memory Agent for Query-Agnostic Online Frame Selection
item.description:
中文标题：SVMemAgent：一种用于查询无关在线帧选择的流式视频记忆智能体

作者：Dohwan Ko, Ji Soo Lee, Pierce Chuang, Debojeet Chatterjee, Ashish Shenoy, Yichao Lu, Seungwhan Moon, Xin Luna Dong, Vikas Bhardwaj, Hyunwoo J. Kim

Abstract: Most keyframe selection studies focus on offline settings, assuming access to the full video and query in advance. In contrast, real-world streaming scenarios require online frame selection under unknown video duration, without access to either the query or future frames during selection. To address this, we introduce Streaming Video Memory (SVMem), a compact and representative memory of previously observed content, updated continuously as the video stream unfolds. Building on this setting, we propose the Streaming Video Memory Agent (SVMemAgent), which dynamically maintains a memory by deciding at each timestep whether to replace an existing memory frame with the incoming frame or discard it. SVMemAgent is trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-driven rewards derived from diverse question-answer pairs, implicitly exposing the policy to a distribution of queries during training so that SVMem retains generally informative frames at inference, when queries are unavailable. Experiments on both online and offline video benchmarks show that SVMemAgent consistently outperforms online frame selection baselines and achieves competitive performance with offline methods that assume access to the full video and query. Through task-driven rewards, SVMemAgent learns an emergent keyframe selection policy that prefers frames containing textual information, which may benefit downstream VideoQA tasks.

中文摘要：大多数关键帧选择研究聚焦于离线场景，假设可以预先访问完整视频和查询。相比之下，现实流式场景需要在未知视频时长、且选择时无法访问查询或未来帧的条件下进行在线帧选择。为此，作者引入流式视频记忆（SVMem），一种对已观察内容的紧凑且具代表性的记忆，随着视频流展开而持续更新。基于此设定，提出流式视频记忆智能体（SVMemAgent），它在每个时间步决定是用新到达的帧替换现有记忆帧还是丢弃它，从而动态维护记忆。SVMemAgent使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练，奖励来自多样化问答对的任务驱动信号，在训练中隐式地将策略暴露于查询分布，使得推理时即使没有查询，SVMem也能保留一般性信息丰富的帧。在线和离线视频基准实验表明，SVMemAgent持续优于在线帧选择基线，并与假设可访问完整视频和查询的离线方法达到有竞争力的性能。通过任务驱动奖励，SVMemAgent学习到一种涌现的关键帧选择策略，偏好包含文本信息的帧，这可能有利于下游视频问答任务。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将流式视频记忆与强化学习结合，为在线帧选择提供了一种查询无关的解决方案；其涌现的偏好文本帧策略可能对需要处理连续视频流的时空数据挖掘任务有借鉴意义，但摘要未说明其在城市或地理场景中的直接应用。

相关度：62/100 该论文研究流式视频中的在线关键帧选择，与时空数据挖掘和多智能体/LLM方向有一定关联，但未涉及城市更新或遥感变化检测，相关性中等。
