item.title: Learning from Distributed Eyes: Leveraging Collaborative Perception for Automated Model Adaptation
item.description:
中文标题：从分布式眼睛中学习：利用协同感知实现自动模型适应

作者：Yanan Ma, Yihang Tao, Zhengru Fang, Zihan Fang, Yiqin Deng, Xianhao Chen, and Yuguang Fang

Abstract: In autonomous driving, perception models often struggle to generalize to new environments due to domain shifts. While unsupervised model adaptation offers a feasible solution without labor-intensive manual labeling, existing methods that rely solely on the ego-vehicle's data often lead to inferior pseudo-labeling performance. To address this critical issue, we propose LDE, Learning from Distributed ``Eyes", a novel framework that transforms collaborative perception (CP) into a source of high-quality supervision for model adaptation. This pseudo-labeling approach is hyperparameter-insensitive and relatively reliable, assuming CP often outperforms single-agent's perception. However, naively implementing this approach encounters (1) the communication bottleneck of sharing rich features under time and bandwidth constraints, (2) the view discrepancy between the CP view and the learner's Field of View (FoV), and (3) the unreliability even in CP-generated labels. To address these issues, we design an adaptation-oriented feature sharing mechanism that selectively transmits the most critical information for adaptation, an FoV filtering method that meticulously eliminates mismatched labels, and a curriculum learning strategy to progressively exploit pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on 3D object detection tasks demonstrate that LDE consistently outperforms both the pre-trained models and state-of-the-art unsupervised adaptation methods.

中文摘要：在自动驾驶中，感知模型常因域偏移而难以泛化到新环境。虽然无监督模型适应无需劳动密集型人工标注即可提供可行方案，但仅依赖自车数据的现有方法往往导致伪标签性能不佳。为解决这一关键问题，作者提出LDE（Learning from Distributed "Eyes"），一种将协同感知（CP）转化为模型适应高质量监督来源的新框架。这种伪标签方法对超参数不敏感且相对可靠，假设CP通常优于单智能体感知。然而，朴素实现该方法会遇到三个问题：（1）在时间和带宽约束下共享丰富特征的通信瓶颈；（2）CP视图与学习器视场（FoV）之间的视角差异；（3）即使CP生成的标签也不可靠。为解决这些问题，作者设计了面向适应的特征共享机制，选择性传输对适应最关键的信息；一种FoV过滤方法，细致消除不匹配标签；以及一种课程学习策略，逐步利用伪标签。在3D目标检测任务上的大量实验表明，LDE持续优于预训练模型和最先进的无监督适应方法。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将多智能体协同感知作为伪标签来源，并设计特征共享、FoV过滤和课程学习来应对通信与视角差异；其多源数据融合与域适应思路可能对地理空间智能中多平台（如卫星与无人机）协同观测有启发，但摘要未涉及地理空间场景。

相关度：55/100 该论文研究利用协同感知进行自动驾驶模型的无监督域适应，涉及多智能体感知与3D目标检测，与多智能体、多源数据融合方向相关，但未涉及城市更新或遥感变化检测。

To address these issues, we design an adaptation-oriented feature sharing mechanism that selectively transmits the most critical information for adaptation, an FoV filtering method that meticulously eliminates mismatched labels, and a curriculum learning strategy to progressively exploit pseudo labels. 中文摘要：在自动驾驶中，感知模型常因域偏移而难以泛化到新环境。虽然无监督模型适应无需劳动密集型人工标注即可提供可行方案，但仅依赖自车数据的现有方法往往导致伪标签性能不佳。为解决这一关键问题，作者提出LDE（Learning from Distributed "Eyes"），一种将协同感知（CP）转化为模型适应高质量监督来源的新框架。这种伪标签方法对超参数不敏感且相对可靠，假设CP通常优于单智能体感知。然而，朴素实现该方法会遇到三个问题：（1）在时间和带宽约束下共享丰富特征的通信瓶颈；（2）CP视图与学习器视场（FoV）之间的视角差异；（3）即使CP生成的标签也不可靠。为解决这些问题，作者设计了面向适应的特征共享机制，选择性传输对适应最关键的信息；一种FoV过滤方法，细致消除不匹配标签；以及一种课程学习策略，逐步利用伪标签。在3D目标检测任务上的大量实验表明，LDE持续优于预训练模型和最先进的无监督适应方法。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将多智能体协同感知作为伪标签来源，并设计特征共享、FoV过滤和课程学习来应对通信与视角差异；其多源数据融合与域适应思路可能对地理空间智能中多平台（如卫星与无人机）协同观测有启发，但摘要未涉及地理空间场景。

相关度：55/100 该论文研究利用协同感知进行自动驾驶模型的无监督域适应，涉及多智能体感知与3D目标检测，与多智能体、多源数据融合方向相关，但未涉及城市更新或遥感变化检测。

item.title: Semantic-ITC: A Frame-wise Indoor Mobile Laser Scanning Dataset and Benchmark for Semantic Segmentation
item.description:
中文标题：Semantic-ITC：面向语义分割的帧级室内移动激光扫描数据集与基准

作者：Haiyang Wu, Muhammad Affan, George Vosselman, Ville Lehtola

Abstract: Semantic labels for indoor mobile laser scanning (MLS) frames remain largely absent from current point cloud semantic segmentation benchmarks, which mainly focus on reconstructed indoor scenes or outdoor LiDAR perception. This paper introduces Semantic-ITC, to the best of our knowledge the first public dataset and benchmark for frame-wise indoor MLS semantic segmentation. The dataset contains 52 indoor sequences, 79,108 MLS frames, and 1.23 billion labeled points collected in classrooms, corridors, meeting rooms, offices, and study areas. Labels are attached directly to measured LiDAR points in each frame using 16 semantic classes covering structural elements, furniture, room equipment, vegetation, and other indoor objects. Semantic-ITC preserves the sparse, non-uniform, and frame-wise sampling pattern of indoor MLS, making it distinct from scene-level reconstructed point clouds and mesh-based indoor datasets. The annotations are produced by a hybrid workflow that combines predictions from a visual foundation model applied to synchronized RGB images, structural information from BIM, and manual refinement, with the final labels assigned to the original LiDAR frames. A single-frame benchmark is provided, and the best baseline reaches 79.27\% mIoU. Remaining errors are concentrated around object boundaries and ambiguous indoor classes, indicating the challenges of indoor MLS segmentation under sparse frame geometry and long-tailed class distributions. The dataset provides a public benchmark for evaluating semantic segmentation directly on measured indoor MLS frames and supports future studies on frame-wise indoor MLS semantic segmentation.

中文摘要：当前点云语义分割基准主要关注重建后的室内场景或室外LiDAR感知，室内移动激光扫描帧的语义标签仍基本缺失。本文提出Semantic-ITC，据作者所知是首个公开的帧级室内MLS语义分割数据集与基准。该数据集包含52个室内序列、79,108个MLS帧和12.3亿个标注点，采集于教室、走廊、会议室、办公室和学习区。标签直接附着于每帧中实测的LiDAR点，使用16个语义类别，覆盖结构元素、家具、房间设备、植被和其他室内物体。Semantic-ITC保留了室内MLS稀疏、非均匀和帧级采样的特点，区别于场景级重建点云和基于网格的室内数据集。标注通过混合流程生成，结合视觉基础模型对同步RGB图像的预测、来自BIM的结构信息和人工精修，最终标签分配给原始LiDAR帧。作者提供单帧基准，最佳基线达到79.27% mIoU。剩余误差集中在物体边界和模糊室内类别，表明稀疏帧几何和长尾类别分布下室内MLS分割的挑战。该数据集为直接在实测室内MLS帧上评估语义分割提供公开基准，并支持未来帧级室内MLS语义分割研究。

研究启发（模型推断）：该数据集将BIM结构信息、视觉基础模型预测与人工精修结合，为多源融合标注提供了可借鉴流程；其帧级、稀疏、长尾的设定也提示城市室内空间数字化与更新中的点云分割仍需针对采样特性设计方法。

相关度：62/100 该文发布帧级室内移动激光扫描语义分割数据集与基准，涉及点云语义分割、BIM与视觉基础模型融合标注，属于多源数据融合与三维地理空间智能范畴，但与城市更新和遥感变化检测的直接关联有限。

item.title: PDA++: Field-Aligned Planning and Scene-Adaptive Insertion in Remote Sensing
item.description:
中文标题：PDA++：遥感中的场对齐规划与场景自适应插入

作者：Xianchi Dong, Yingyan Hou, Chao Ren, Wanxuan Lu, Zihan Wei, Hongfeng Yu, Yixiao Wang, Chubo Deng, Xian Sun

Abstract: Remote sensing recognition is often constrained by scarce observations of rare targets and costly annotations, making realistic synthetic augmentation particularly valuable for few-shot and long-tailed scenarios. Object insertion provides an efficient way to increase target diversity while preserving authentic background scenes, but realistic insertion in overhead imagery requires the generated target to adapt coherently to its surrounding environment. To this end, we propose PDA++, a unified environment-aware object insertion framework organized as Plan, Decouple, and Assimilate. Planning determines scene-compatible poses through an affordance field that combines geometric clearance with structure- and scale-aware cues. Decoupling introduces a pose-conditioned background that provides precise spatial guidance together with target-scene context, allowing the reference object to preserve its identity while adapting to the target observation. This construction also naturally provides pixel-level masks for segmentation augmentation. Assimilation further improves local coherence by aligning multi-scale texture distributions through optimal transport. On the optical benchmark, PDA++ achieves a whole-image FID of 6.28 and improves average few-shot recognition mAP50 by 17.69 points, corresponding to a 28.8% relative gain over the real-data baseline. On SAR imagery, it improves ship detection by 4.10 mAP50 points and remains effective under cross-dataset transfer and amorphous-target insertion. Code is available at https://github.com/lisheyu972/PDA_PLUS.

中文摘要：遥感识别常受稀有目标观测稀缺和标注成本高的限制，因此逼真的合成增强对少样本和长尾场景尤为有价值。目标插入可在保留真实背景场景的同时高效增加目标多样性，但在俯视影像中实现逼真插入需要生成目标与周围环境协调一致。为此，作者提出PDA++，一个统一的环境感知目标插入框架，组织为规划、解耦和同化三部分。规划通过结合几何间隙与结构、尺度感知线索的可供性场确定场景兼容姿态。解耦引入姿态条件背景，提供精确空间引导和目标-场景上下文，使参考目标在保持身份的同时适应目标观测，并自然提供用于分割增强的像素级掩码。同化通过最优传输对齐多尺度纹理分布，进一步提升局部一致性。在光学基准上，PDA++取得整图FID 6.28，并将平均少样本识别mAP50提升17.69点，相对真实数据基线提升28.8%。在SAR影像上，船舶检测mAP50提升4.10点，并在跨数据集迁移和非定形目标插入下仍然有效。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作表明，环境感知的目标插入可同时服务于识别增强与分割掩码生成，其跨光学与SAR的迁移效果提示该思路或可缓解城市更新遥感监测中稀有地物样本不足的问题，但具体泛化能力仍需在更多场景验证。

相关度：58/100 该文面向遥感识别中稀有目标观测稀缺和标注昂贵的问题，提出环境感知的目标插入框架以增强少样本和长尾场景，涉及遥感影像合成、分割掩码生成与跨数据集迁移，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合中的样本增强需求相关。

item.title: Attention Dispersion as a Diagnostic Signal for Hallucination in Large Language Models
item.description:
中文标题：注意力分散作为大语言模型幻觉的诊断信号

作者：Shardul P. More, Tanuja S. Pawar

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit hallucinations, presenting a major barrier to reliability in complex reasoning tasks. While traditional detection methods rely on output-based confidence metrics, these logits are often miscalibrated by modern alignment techniques. In this paper, we investigate the temporal volatility of internal attention mechanisms as an alternative diagnostic signal for hallucination that does not depend on output calibration. By introducing an unsupervised metric for attention dispersion, we show that epistemic uncertainty leaves a measurable trace within intermediate layers, where spikes in attention entropy are associated with reasoning breakdowns. We evaluate our approach on mathematical reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K and MATH-500) using the Qwen2.5 model family (1.5B and 3B parameters), finding statistically significant AUC improvements of up to +0.076 over output-based baselines across all tested conditions. These findings suggest that attention dispersion is a promising complement to traditional hallucination detection methods, requiring further investigation across broader model families and task domains.

中文摘要：大语言模型（LLM）经常出现幻觉，这成为复杂推理任务可靠性的主要障碍。传统检测方法依赖基于输出的置信度指标，但这些logits常被现代对齐技术错误校准。本文研究内部注意力机制的时间波动性，作为不依赖输出校准的幻觉诊断替代信号。作者引入一种无监督的注意力分散度量，表明认知不确定性在中间层留下可测量的痕迹，注意力熵的尖峰与推理崩溃相关。在数学推理基准（GSM8K和MATH-500）上使用Qwen2.5模型系列（1.5B和3B参数）评估，发现所有测试条件下AUC相比基于输出的基线最高提升+0.076，且具有统计显著性。这些发现表明注意力分散是传统幻觉检测方法的有前景补充，需要在更广泛的模型家族和任务领域进一步研究。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，内部注意力动态可作为不依赖输出校准的幻觉诊断信号；但其结论基于Qwen2.5系列在数学推理基准上的实验，跨模型家族与任务领域的泛化性尚待验证。

相关度：62/100 该文研究LLM幻觉的注意力分散诊断信号，与研究者关注的LLM与多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用，属于方法层面的基础研究。

item.title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering
item.description:
中文标题：基于知识图谱的增强与检索增强生成在文化相关问答中的对比

作者：Pablo Poulenard, Yannis Karmim, Valentin Barri\`ere

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability. We benchmark Graph-RAG against standard RAG on LatamQA, a culturally grounded multiple-choice dataset spanning eight thematic categories. The graphs are built end-to-end from Wikipedia articles with KGGen, a recent open-domain extractor, without manual curation in our main setting. G-Retriever is competitive with RAG and reduces the error of the base LLM by 72\% with a standard KG and 78\% with a benchmark-aware variant, the gap to RAG narrowing further as the graph is oriented toward task-relevant content. The trained projection transfers zero-shot to Portuguese without target-language fine-tuning, indicating multilingual reach.

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究表明结构化知识图谱在文化长尾问答中可部分替代或补充RAG，且图谱内容与任务相关性的对齐程度会影响其相对优势；零样本跨语言迁移提示该投影方式可能具备一定语言无关性。

中文标题：基于知识图谱的增强与检索增强生成在文化相关问答中的对比

作者：Pablo Poulenard, Yannis Karmim, Valentin Barri\`ere

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability. We benchmark Graph-RAG against standard RAG on LatamQA, a culturally grounded multiple-choice dataset spanning eight thematic categories. The graphs are built end-to-end from Wikipedia articles with KGGen, a recent open-domain extractor, without manual curation in our main setting. G-Retriever is competitive with RAG and reduces the error of the base LLM by 72\% with a standard KG and 78\% with a benchmark-aware variant, the gap to RAG narrowing further as the graph is oriented toward task-relevant content. The trained projection transfers zero-shot to Portuguese without target-language fine-tuning, indicating multilingual reach.

item.title: Multi-View Mixture-of-Experts with Vision-Language Reranking for Cross-View Object Geo-Localization
item.description:
中文标题：面向跨视角目标地理定位的多视角混合专家与视觉语言重排序

作者：Xuyu Fan, Qi Ming, Zhu Han, Liuqian Wang, Siyuan Cao, Xiaohan Zhang, Xudong Zhao, Mingjing Zhao, Yuhan Zhang

Abstract: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) locates a target in satellite imagery using drone or street-view queries. Existing methods train separate detectors for each viewpoint, leading to parameter redundancy and impeding cross-view knowledge sharing. Moreover, top-ranked satellite candidates are often visually similar, so visual appearance and categorical labels alone are insufficient to resolve such ambiguity. To address these, we propose MVLGeo, an efficient framework designed to unify multiple viewpoints and reduce model redundancy. First, we introduce environmental contextual text from the query view as cues to distinguish visually similar candidates via Vision-Language Reranking (VL-Rerank). Second, we design a multi-view Mixture-of-Experts architecture (MV-MoE) with a shared encoder and view-specific experts to reduce redundancy and promote knowledge sharing, while cross-view contrastive learning aligns their representations for consistency. Third, we introduce an adaptive elliptical prior (ESAM-Prior) as auxiliary positional encoding for anisotropic geometric perception. Extensive experiments on the CVOGL benchmarks confirm that MVLGeo, as a unified model for multiple query viewpoints, achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating robustness to input degradation and generalization across viewpoints. Code and models will be available on GitHub to facilitate future work.

中文摘要：跨视角目标地理定位（CVOGL）使用无人机或街景查询在卫星影像中定位目标。现有方法为每个视角训练单独的检测器，导致参数冗余并阻碍跨视角知识共享。此外，排名靠前的卫星候选往往视觉相似，仅凭视觉外观和类别标签不足以解决这种歧义。为解决这些问题，我们提出MVLGeo，一个旨在统一多视角并减少模型冗余的高效框架。首先，我们引入来自查询视角的环境上下文文本作为线索，通过视觉语言重排序（VL-Rerank）区分视觉相似的候选。其次，我们设计多视角混合专家架构（MV-MoE），具有共享编码器和视角特定专家，以减少冗余并促进知识共享，同时跨视角对比学习对齐其表示以保持一致性。第三，我们引入自适应椭圆先验（ESAM-Prior）作为辅助位置编码，用于各向异性几何感知。在CVOGL基准上的大量实验证实，MVLGeo作为多查询视角的统一模型达到最先进性能，展示了对输入退化的鲁棒性和跨视角泛化能力。代码和模型将在GitHub上提供以促进未来工作。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究将视觉语言模型与混合专家架构引入跨视角地理定位，其多视角统一建模和上下文重排序思路可启发城市遥感中的目标检索与多源影像融合；但需注意其验证限于CVOGL基准，向城市更新或变化检测场景迁移尚需进一步研究。

相关度：72/100 该文研究跨视角目标地理定位，使用无人机/街景查询在卫星影像中定位目标，属于遥感与地理空间视觉交叉方向，涉及多视角融合、视觉语言重排序和混合专家架构，与GIS研究中的遥感变化检测、多源数据融合和地理空间智能高度相关。

item.title: Mask 2D-3D: Adaptive Dual-Masked Autoencoder Network for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
item.description:
中文标题：Mask 2D-3D：用于图像到点云配准的自适应双掩码自编码器网络

作者：Zhixin Cheng, Jiacheng Deng, Xiaotian Yin, Baoqun Yin, Richang Hong, Tianzhu Zhang

Abstract: Detection-free methods for image-to-point cloud registration are prone to erroneous correspondences caused by domain and modality discrepancies, limited sensitivity of feature extractors, and the presence of non-overlapping regions. The Masked Autoencoder (MAE) has shown strong performance in visual representation for images and point clouds. It may be helpful to apply this approach to image-to-point cloud registration, a task that requires unified feature extraction and accurate cross-modal correspondences. Standard MAE's random masking may overlook key regions due to limited camera views, reducing registration effectiveness. To address this, we propose the Intermodal Dual-MAE Framework (ID-MAE) with a Similarity-based RL Masking Strategy (SRLM), which adaptively masks informative positions by leveraging cross-modal similarity and reinforcement learning, thus narrowing the modality gap. Our method enhances cross-modal representation learning by enforcing representation consistency during feature extraction, thereby enabling more reliable 2D-3D correspondence estimation. Experiments on RGB-D Scenes v2 and 7-Scenes benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in image-to-point cloud registration.

中文摘要：针对图像到点云配准中因域与模态差异、特征提取器敏感度有限以及非重叠区域导致的错误对应问题，本文提出跨模态双掩码自编码器框架（ID-MAE）及基于相似度的强化学习掩码策略（SRLM）。该方法利用跨模态相似度与强化学习自适应地掩蔽信息量大的位置，缩小模态差距，并通过在特征提取阶段强制表示一致性增强跨模态表示学习，从而实现更可靠的2D-3D对应估计。在RGB-D Scenes v2与7-Scenes基准上取得当前最优的配准性能。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示，将掩码自编码器与自适应掩码策略结合，可能为跨模态（如遥感影像与点云/深度数据）配准提供统一特征提取与对应估计的思路，但其在真实大范围地理空间场景中的适用性尚需验证。

相关度：62/100 该文研究图像到点云的无检测配准，采用双掩码自编码器与强化学习掩码策略实现跨模态特征提取与对应估计，与多源数据融合和地理空间智能中的跨模态配准问题相关，但未涉及城市更新或时空数据挖掘。

item.title: Finder: Agentic Closed-Loop Object Finding for Embodied Grounding
item.description:
中文标题：Finder：面向具身定位的智能体闭环目标查找

作者：Shixiong Xu, Zhiyuan Chen, Song Ding, Rui Luo, Xiaowei Liang, Dongxu Miao, Zhiying Du

Abstract: Finding the object referred to by language in a partially observed 3D scene is a core capability for embodied agents. Existing approaches either couple object search with online exploration, which can be costly when relevant observations have already been captured, or query pre-built open-vocabulary maps and scene graphs in a static, one-shot fashion. We present Finder, an agentic closed-loop object-finding primitive for embodied grounding. Instead of treating grounding as passive retrieval from a fixed scene representation, Finder maintains a typed loop state that links query-conditioned planning, scoped evidence gathering, candidate verification, and accept/continue/abort control. When evidence is incomplete or ambiguous, the loop can redirect subsequent perception and comparison rather than simply returning the top retrieved object. On open-vocabulary embodied Object Retrieval in Habitat/HM3D and real-world RGB-D scenes, Finder improves the averaged 1m success rate by 15.75 points over strong baselines. The same primitive also transfers to sequential object grounding and embodied object-centric question answering, improving spatial and temporal localization without changing the inner grounding protocol. Project page: https://finder-vln.github.io.

中文摘要：在部分观测的3D场景中查找语言指代的目标是具身智能体的核心能力。现有方法或将目标搜索与在线探索耦合（当相关观测已被捕获时代价高昂），或以静态一次性方式查询预建的开放词汇地图与场景图。本文提出Finder，一种面向具身定位的智能体闭环目标查找原语。Finder不将定位视为从固定场景表示中的被动检索，而是维护一个类型化循环状态，连接查询条件规划、范围化证据收集、候选验证与接受/继续/中止控制；当证据不完整或模糊时，循环可重定向后续感知与比较，而非简单返回检索到的最高分目标。在Habitat/HM3D的开放词汇具身目标检索与真实RGB-D场景中，Finder将平均1米成功率较强基线提升15.75个百分点，并可迁移至序列目标定位与具身目标中心问答。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文的闭环智能体框架提示，将规划、证据收集与验证耦合可能提升复杂空间环境中的目标定位鲁棒性，其思路或可启发城市环境中基于多源观测的目标搜索与验证，但实验场景为室内，向城市尺度的迁移需重新设计。

相关度：58/100 该文提出具身智能中的闭环目标查找原语，涉及3D场景中的开放词汇目标检索与空间定位，与地理空间智能和多智能体/具身智能方向相关，但场景为室内HM3D与RGB-D而非城市或遥感尺度。

item.title: SFT or RL for Tool-Calling Agents? A Controlled Study Across Data, Method, and Scale
item.description:
中文标题：工具调用智能体：SFT还是RL？跨数据、方法与规模的受控研究

作者：Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Xue-Yong Fu, Shashi Bhushan TN

Abstract: Limited controlled evidence exists on how training data, adaptation method, and model scale jointly affect tool-calling performance in language-model agents. We evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with LoRA, reinforcement learning (RL) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and SFT followed by GRPO across six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, covering both in-distribution performance and cross-dataset transfer. SFT with LoRA is the strongest in-distribution method throughout the 0.6B-32B range and best in 15 out of 18 experimental settings. On cross-dataset transfer, the methods are closer: GRPO wins 29 out of 54 settings where training and test datasets differ, but its margin over SFT averages under one point, and SFT->GRPO is rarely strongest in either comparison. Dataset mixing gives consistently strong transfer while staying close to specialized in-distribution training, regardless of method. Additional analysis further confirms that LoRA outperforms full-parameter fine-tuning, demonstrating that LoRA better preserves pretrained agentic behavior.

中文摘要：针对语言模型智能体工具调用性能受训练数据、适配方法和模型规模共同影响但缺乏受控证据的问题，本文评估了LoRA监督微调（SFT）、基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习以及先SFT后GRPO三种方法，覆盖六个Qwen3模型（0.6B至32B参数），考察分布内性能和跨数据集迁移。结果显示，LoRA SFT在0.6B-32B范围内始终是分布内最强方法，在18个实验设置中15个最优；跨数据集迁移时各方法差距缩小，GRPO在54个训练测试数据集不同的设置中胜出29个，但平均优势不足一分，SFT->GRPO在两种比较中都很少最强。数据集混合能带来稳定强迁移且接近专门分布内训练。分析还确认LoRA优于全参数微调，能更好保留预训练的智能体行为。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，在地理空间智能体工具调用场景中，若任务分布相对固定，LoRA SFT可能是更稳妥的选择；若需跨数据集迁移，可考虑GRPO或数据混合策略，但需注意其优势有限。

相关度：62/100 该文系统比较了SFT与RL在工具调用智能体中的表现，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，可为构建地理空间智能体提供训练策略参考。

item.title: RoboVAD: A Large Cross-Domain Evaluation Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Robotic Arm Manipulation Videos
item.description:
中文标题：RoboVAD：机器人臂操作视频异常检测的大规模跨域评估基准

作者：Alexandru-Bogdan Dura, Sebastian Balmus, Radu Tudor Ionescu

Abstract: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is an actively studied task, having wide applications in typical scenarios such as public surveillance and road traffic safety. The task is also relevant for robotic arm interactions, where it has several downstream applications, including learning better interaction and manipulation abilities, triggering recovery procedures when anomalies occur, etc. Despite its relevance, the exploration of anomaly detection in robotic arm manipulation videos is limited by the low number of available resources. To this end, we introduce RoboVAD, a large-scale benchmark for video anomaly detection that comprises challenging cross-domain evaluation scenarios, where certain actions (tasks executed by a robotic arm) and anomaly types (mistakes that occur while performing certain tasks) remain unseen during training. RoboVAD is designed to benchmark VAD methods in realistic scenarios, where robotic arms can perform unforeseen tasks, and thereby encounter new anomaly types. We train and evaluate several state-of-the-art VAD methods, including a novel method specifically adapted for robotic arm manipulation. While the proposed method outperforms many state-of-the-art competitors, all methods remain below a micro-averaged frame-level AUC threshold of 70% in the most challenging evaluation setup, confirming the difficulty of the proposed benchmark. We publicly release our dataset and code at https://zenodo.org/records/22754659.

中文摘要：视频异常检测（VAD）是活跃研究任务，在公共监控和道路交通安全等典型场景有广泛应用，也与机器人臂交互相关，可用于学习更好的交互与操作能力、在异常发生时触发恢复程序等。然而机器人臂操作视频的异常检测研究受限于可用资源稀少。为此，本文提出RoboVAD，一个大规模视频异常检测基准，包含具有挑战性的跨域评估场景，其中某些动作（机器人臂执行的任务）和异常类型（执行任务时发生的错误）在训练中未出现。RoboVAD旨在真实场景下对VAD方法进行基准测试，即机器人臂可执行未预见任务并因此遇到新异常类型。作者训练并评估了多种先进VAD方法，包括一种专门适配机器人臂操作的新方法。虽然所提方法优于许多先进竞争者，但在最具挑战性的评估设置中，所有方法均低于70%的微平均帧级AUC阈值，证实了该基准的难度。数据集和代码已公开。

研究启发（模型推断）：该基准的跨域评估设计（未见任务与未见异常类型）对遥感变化检测中的跨区域泛化评估有借鉴意义，但其关注的是机器人操作视频，与城市更新时空数据挖掘的直接关联有限。

相关度：58/100 该文构建机器人臂操作视频异常检测基准，涉及视频理解与跨域评估，与遥感变化检测在方法上有一定相通性，但应用领域不同。

item.title: A Systematic Evaluation of the COTQ Provincial Land Cover Product: Structural Consistency, Spectral Separability, and Relative Positioning Against ESA, ESRI, and Google Products
item.description:
中文标题：COTQ省级土地覆盖产品的系统评估：结构一致性、光谱可分性及相对于ESA、ESRI和Google产品的定位

作者：\'Etienne Clabaut, Samuel Foucher, Yacine Bouroubi

Abstract: High-resolution land use and land cover (LULC) products derived from Sentinel-2 imagery are widely used for environmental monitoring and land management, yet their performance can vary across regions with complex ecological gradients and heterogeneous surface conditions. In Quebec, these limitations motivated the development of a provincial 10-m land-cover product, the COTQ, designed to support annual monitoring of land occupation and soil artificialisation. This study presents a systematic evaluation of the COTQ product relative to three global 10-m LULC datasets: ESA WorldCover, ESRI LandCover, and Google DynamicWorld. This paper does not introduce a new mapping methodology but focuses on analysing the behaviour and consistency of the COTQ using complementary evaluation approaches. All products are harmonized under a common legend and compared using structural indicators (object-size distributions, shape complexity, Adjusted Rand Index, and Intersection over Union), spectral separability metrics derived from Sentinel-2 reflectance data, and a targeted photo-interpretation of disagreement areas. The analysis is conducted over eight Sentinel-2 tiles selected to represent the main bioclimatic domains of Qu\'ebec, from temperate and boreal forests to northern tundra environments. The results show that the COTQ exhibits structural and spectral characteristics most similar to ESA WorldCover among the reference global products, while revealing systematic differences linked to class definitions and thematic priorities, particularly for urban areas, wetlands, and rocky or cryptogamic surfaces. This multi-criteria evaluation provides an objective characterization of the COTQ product and clarifies its relative positioning with respect to existing global land-cover datasets for operational land monitoring in Qu\'ebec.

中文摘要：源自Sentinel-2影像的高分辨率土地利用与土地覆盖（LULC）产品广泛用于环境监测和土地管理，但在生态梯度复杂、地表条件异质的区域，其表现可能不同。在魁北克，这些局限促使开发了省级10米土地覆盖产品COTQ，旨在支持土地占用和土壤人工化的年度监测。本研究对COTQ产品相对于三个全球10米LULC数据集进行系统评估：ESA WorldCover、ESRI LandCover和Google DynamicWorld。本文不引入新的制图方法，而是聚焦于使用互补评估方法分析COTQ的行为和一致性。所有产品在共同图例下协调，并使用结构指标（对象大小分布、形状复杂度、调整兰德指数和交并比）、源自Sentinel-2反射率数据的光谱可分性指标，以及对分歧区域的针对性照片判读进行比较。分析在八个Sentinel-2瓦片上进行，这些瓦片被选以代表魁北克的主要生物气候域，从温带和北方森林到北部苔原环境。结果表明，在参考全球产品中，COTQ表现出与ESA WorldCover最相似的结构和光谱特征，同时揭示了与类别定义和主题优先级相关的系统性差异，特别是在城市区域、湿地以及岩石或隐花植物表面。这种多准则评估提供了对COTQ产品的客观刻画，并阐明了其相对于现有全球土地覆盖数据集的相对定位。

研究启发（模型推断）：该评估提示：COTQ在结构和光谱特征上与ESA WorldCover最相似，但在城市、湿地和岩石/隐花植物表面存在与类别定义和主题优先级相关的系统性差异；多准则评估可用于客观刻画区域产品并明确其相对定位。

相关度：88/100 该文系统评估魁北克省级10米土地覆盖产品COTQ，与ESA、ESRI、Google全球产品对比，涉及结构一致性、光谱可分性与产品相对定位，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合及地理空间智能高度相关。

item.title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
item.description:
中文标题：经验带来置信：从推理到智能体的经验性置信度估计

作者：Caiqi Zhang, Xiaochen Zhu, Chengzu Li, Yulong Chen, Dharshan Kumaran, Nigel Collier

Abstract: Reliable confidence estimation is increasingly central to the trustworthy deployment of language models: a calibrated estimate of the probability that an output is correct decides what to ship, what to escalate, and what to retry. Existing confidence estimators, however, share one design premise: they only read the current inference process, either by introspecting on it, scoring its token probabilities, or resampling it. We argue that the current inference is not a sufficient basis for confidence. We propose XConf (eXperiential Confidence): estimating confidence together with the model's accumulated experience. The experience is stored as a record of the model's own graded past episodes, each holding the task, the model's reflection, its stated confidence, the outcome, and a lesson written once the grade arrived. Given a new task, XConf's Recall stage retrieves past episodes on similar tasks met with a similar stated confidence, and reads off their historical success rate; its Reflect stage shows the model this record, has it name its recurring failure mode, and restate a confidence now informed by its own track records. Our estimator is format-general, requiring no logit access or weight updates, and costs only one answer generation. Across nine benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, multimodal QA, and interactive agents, and four models from three families, XConf beats or matches ten-sample self-consistency in discrimination (AUROC) on 23 of 24 comparisons, with much lower calibration error (ECE), at a tenth of the generation cost. Used for selective prediction, abstaining on the 10% least-confident episodes raises the delivered success rate by up to 8.7 points on agent tasks. We therefore see experiential confidence estimation as a new paradigm for future general-purpose confidence estimation.

研究启发（模型推断）：该文提示：智能体的可靠性不仅取决于单次推理，还取决于对自身历史成败的经验性记忆与校准弃答；这一思路可迁移到多智能体协作与时空决策场景中的不确定性管理，但文中并未涉及地理空间数据或城市应用。

相关度：62/100 该文提出基于历史经验记录的置信度估计方法XConf，直接服务于LLM与智能体的可靠部署，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
item.content:encoded:
中文标题：经验带来置信：从推理到智能体的经验性置信度估计

作者：Caiqi Zhang, Xiaochen Zhu, Chengzu Li, Yulong Chen, Dharshan Kumaran, Nigel Collier

Abstract: Reliable confidence estimation is increasingly central to the trustworthy deployment of language models: a calibrated estimate of the probability that an output is correct decides what to ship, what to escalate, and what to retry. Existing confidence estimators, however, share one design premise: they only read the current inference process, either by introspecting on it, scoring its token probabilities, or resampling it. We argue that the current inference is not a sufficient basis for confidence. We propose XConf (eXperiential Confidence): estimating confidence together with the model's accumulated experience. The experience is stored as a record of the model's own graded past episodes, each holding the task, the model's reflection, its stated confidence, the outcome, and a lesson written once the grade arrived. Given a new task, XConf's Recall stage retrieves past episodes on similar tasks met with a similar stated confidence, and reads off their historical success rate; its Reflect stage shows the model this record, has it name its recurring failure mode, and restate a confidence now informed by its own track records. Our estimator is format-general, requiring no logit access or weight updates, and costs only one answer generation. Across nine benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, multimodal QA, and interactive agents, and four models from three families, XConf beats or matches ten-sample self-consistency in discrimination (AUROC) on 23 of 24 comparisons, with much lower calibration error (ECE), at a tenth of the generation cost. Used for selective prediction, abstaining on the 10% least-confident episodes raises the delivered success rate by up to 8.7 points on agent tasks. We therefore see experiential confidence estimation as a new paradigm for future general-purpose confidence estimation.

item.title: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
item.description:
中文标题：反思、修订、复用：GUI智能体的免训练技能演化

作者：Bofan Chen, Boxuan Zhang, Fei Tang, Zhengxi Lu, Yong Du, Tongbo Chen, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen

Abstract: GUI agents execute long-horizon tasks on dynamic graphical user interfaces, where pop-ups, delayed loads, and relocated widgets routinely invalidate plans fixed before execution. Recent agent-skill frameworks encapsulate reusable procedural knowledge to mitigate this, yet existing skill designs are largely developed without targeting GUI execution dynamics and treat skills as static artifacts produced before deployment rather than living procedural knowledge that improves through it. We argue that what GUI agents need is not better static skills, but skills that can be revised from execution feedback at deployment time, without additional training. We propose \textbf{EvoSkill-GUI}, a training-free framework in which each skill is a structured multi-file package containing retrieval metadata, executable plans, backup localization, failure-recovery rules, accessibility utilities, and failure cases. EvoSkill-GUI operates through a \textbf{\emph{reflect-revise-reuse}} loop: the executor performs instant in-rollout revisions, an isolated critic diagnoses failed trajectories under strict information isolation, and the executor edits specific skill files through a restricted tool interface. Across MobileWorld, AndroidWorld, and OSWorld, three mainstream GUI benchmarks spanning mobile and desktop platforms, EvoSkill-GUI consistently improves multiple base models without any training, with maximum gains of $+16.2\%$, $+6.0\%$, and $+10.5\%$ respectively, and evolved skill libraries continue to benefit related tasks rather than being rebuilt from scratch. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/EvoSkill-GUI.

中文摘要：GUI智能体在动态图形界面上执行长时程任务，弹窗、延迟加载和控件移位常常使执行前固定的计划失效。近期的智能体技能框架通过封装可复用的程序性知识来缓解这一问题，但现有技能设计大多未针对GUI执行动态，且将技能视为部署前产生的静态产物，而非通过部署过程不断改进的活的程序性知识。作者认为GUI智能体需要的不是更好的静态技能，而是能在部署时依据执行反馈修订、无需额外训练的技能。他们提出EvoSkill-GUI，一个免训练框架，其中每个技能是一个结构化多文件包，包含检索元数据、可执行计划、备用定位、失败恢复规则、无障碍工具以及失败案例。EvoSkill-GUI通过“反思—修订—复用”循环运作：执行器在rollout中进行即时修订，一个隔离的评论者在严格信息隔离下诊断失败轨迹，执行器则通过受限工具接口编辑特定技能文件。在MobileWorld、AndroidWorld和OSWorld这三个覆盖移动与桌面平台的主流GUI基准上，EvoSkill-GUI在无需任何训练的情况下持续提升多个基础模型，最大增益分别为+16.2%、+6.0%和+10.5%，且演化后的技能库能继续惠及相关任务，而非从零重建。代码已开源。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文的“反思—修订—复用”技能演化机制与结构化技能包设计，对构建可自我改进的地理空间分析智能体（如自动化GIS工作流）具有方法迁移价值，但论文未涉及地理空间任务。

相关度：58/100 该文提出免训练的GUI智能体技能演化框架，涉及智能体反思、修订与复用，与LLM和多智能体研究高度相关，但应用场景为图形界面操作而非地理空间。

item.title: Multi-Task Learning for Sparsely-Labeled Time Series: A Case Study on Cold-Hardiness Modeling
item.description:
中文标题：稀疏标签时间序列的多任务学习：以耐寒性建模为例

作者：Aseem Saxena, Paola Pes\'antez-Cabrera, Markus Keller, Alan Fern

Abstract: We present a real-world case study of multi-task learning (MTL) for temporal process modeling from limited data with temporally sparse labels. Specifically, we investigate multi-task learning for the important agricultural problem of predicting grape cold hardiness, which is the temperature at which lethal freezing occurs. Cold hardiness changes in response to weather and is difficult to measure directly in the field. Thus, growers rely on predictions to decide when to apply costly frost mitigation measures. We apply recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for daily cold-hardiness prediction from time series weather data. A major challenge is that the cold hardiness response varies across plant cultivars and ground-truth data for each cultivar is temporally sparse and limited. To address this challenge, we investigate multi-task learning (MTL) approaches for combining data, where different tasks correspond to different cultivars. We develop a variety of MTL architectures and evaluate them in both MTL and transfer learning settings. Our results show significant differences between architectures and that certain architectures are able to consistently outperform single-task learning and state-of-the-art scientific models. Additionally, we show similar results for the qualitatively different, but related, task of budbreak prediction. Further, improved accuracy for budbreak and cold hardiness is achieved by a single MTL model that simultaneously learns both tasks.

中文摘要：本文针对时间序列数据有限且标签稀疏的问题，以葡萄耐寒性预测为案例，研究了多任务学习（MTL）方法。通过将不同葡萄品种视为不同任务，结合循环神经网络（RNN），开发了多种MTL架构，并在MTL和迁移学习设置下进行评估。结果表明，特定架构能持续优于单任务学习和现有科学模型，并在相关任务（芽破预测）上也有类似效果。

研究启发（模型推断）：多任务学习能够有效整合多个相关但数据稀疏的任务，通过共享信息提升整体预测性能，其架构选择对最终效果有显著影响。

相关度：75/100 该研究探讨了多任务学习在稀疏标签时间序列建模中的应用，其方法论（多任务架构、迁移学习）对城市更新中的多源时空数据挖掘具有借鉴意义，但应用领域（农业）与城市更新直接关联较弱。

item.title: Bottom-up Modeling of Repeated Elements via Single Image Analysis-by-Synthesis
item.description:
中文标题：基于单图像分析合成的重复元素自底向上建模

作者：Syrine Kalleli, Alexei A. Efros, Mathieu Aubry

Abstract: We address the problem of discovering repeated elements from a single image. In contrast to existing approaches that depend on large annotated datasets, curated multi-image collections, or object segmentation masks, we show that a single image can suffice to learn a meaningful object model in a completely bottom-up fashion, without any prior knowledge beyond a coarse scale prior. Our method learns a tunable image-space prototype of the repeated elements through a reconstruction objective, enabling the model to identify and synthesize consistent object instances within the same image. Experiments on 116 real images from the FSC-147 dataset demonstrate that our method successfully learns coherent element models and captures intra-category variation on challenging images. Qualitative results reveal superior reconstructions and interpretable decompositions compared to classical decomposition, joint alignment, and 3D object modeling methods, while maintaining a simple 2D formulation. These results suggest that meaningful object discovery can emerge from single image learning alone.

中文摘要：提出一种无需大型标注数据集或分割掩码的方法，仅凭单张图像和粗略尺度先验，通过重建目标学习可调图像空间原型，以发现和合成重复元素。在FSC-147数据集116张图像上验证了有效性。

研究启发（模型推断）：单张图像蕴含足够的重复结构信息以学习有意义的对象模型，这为缺乏标注数据的遥感场景中自动发现重复地物提供了潜在途径。

相关度：70/100 研究探索从单张图像中自底向上发现重复元素，与遥感影像中重复地物（如建筑物）的自动提取和建模有较强方法关联，但未涉及地理空间显式信息。

item.title: NSFlow: End-to-End Differentiable Neuro-Symbolic Optical Flow for Visual Odometry
item.description:
中文标题：NSFlow：用于视觉里程计的端到端可微分神经符号光流

作者：Yicheng Lin, Zhipeng Fei, Yuxiu Xu, WenDong Chen, Cong Li, and Bin Han

Abstract: Sparse optical flow provides stable inter-frame correspondence, playing a key role in Visual Odometry (VO) and Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO). Classical optimization-based methods, such as Lucas-Kanade (LK), perform well under small displacements but are sensitive to large motions and illumination changes. Modern regression-based learning methods, while more robust in complex scenes, are often computationally heavy and lack explicit geometric consistency, making them less suitable for efficient VO/VIO front-ends. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid neuro-symbolic framework that combines the strengths of both paradigms. Our method uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract robust feature representations, which is fed into a differentiable LK optimizer to estimate optical flow in an end-to-end trainable manner. Through implicit differentiation, gradients are propagated across the iterative solver, enabling joint optimization of feature extraction and flow estimation. The resulting system integrates seamlessly into existing VO/VIO pipelines and runs in real-time on embedded platforms. Experiments show that our method outperforms conventional optimization-based flow in challenging conditions such as dynamic lighting and low texture, while also achieving higher accuracy and lower latency than purely regression-based alternatives. When deployed in a VIO system, our method demonstrates significant performance improvement, achieving an average error reduction of 42\% on challenging datasets while enhancing tracking stability. The code is publicly available.

中文摘要：本文提出NSFlow，一种结合CNN特征提取和可微分Lucas-Kanade优化器的混合神经符号光流框架。该方法通过隐式微分实现端到端训练，在动态光照和低纹理等挑战性条件下优于传统优化方法，并比纯回归方法更高效。在VIO系统中部署时，平均误差降低了42%。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究展示了将经典几何优化算法嵌入深度学习框架进行端到端训练的可能性，在保持几何一致性的同时获得深度学习的鲁棒性，为高效、稳健的视觉前端提供了新思路。

中文标题：NSFlow：用于视觉里程计的端到端可微分神经符号光流

作者：Yicheng Lin, Zhipeng Fei, Yuxiu Xu, WenDong Chen, Cong Li, and Bin Han

Abstract: Sparse optical flow provides stable inter-frame correspondence, playing a key role in Visual Odometry (VO) and Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO). Classical optimization-based methods, such as Lucas-Kanade (LK), perform well under small displacements but are sensitive to large motions and illumination changes. Modern regression-based learning methods, while more robust in complex scenes, are often computationally heavy and lack explicit geometric consistency, making them less suitable for efficient VO/VIO front-ends. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid neuro-symbolic framework that combines the strengths of both paradigms. Our method uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract robust feature representations, which is fed into a differentiable LK optimizer to estimate optical flow in an end-to-end trainable manner. Through implicit differentiation, gradients are propagated across the iterative solver, enabling joint optimization of feature extraction and flow estimation. The resulting system integrates seamlessly into existing VO/VIO pipelines and runs in real-time on embedded platforms. Experiments show that our method outperforms conventional optimization-based flow in challenging conditions such as dynamic lighting and low texture, while also achieving higher accuracy and lower latency than purely regression-based alternatives. When deployed in a VIO system, our method demonstrates significant performance improvement, achieving an average error reduction of 42\% on challenging datasets while enhancing tracking stability. The code is publicly available.

item.title: Calendar-Structured Sparse Principal Component Analysis for Interpretable Multi-Periodic Electricity Consumption Profiles
item.description:
中文标题：Calendar-SPCA：面向多周期电力消费曲线的可解释表示学习

作者：Carlos Quesada-Granja, Tony Castillo-Calzadilla, Carlos Rizo-Maestre

Abstract: Long-term electricity-consumption profiles exhibit several simultaneous periodic structures, including daily, weekly, and annual cycles. This work introduces Calendar-SPCA, a calendar-structured sparse principal component method that incorporates this known multi-periodic geometry directly into low-dimensional representation learning. The feature domain is represented as the Cartesian product of cyclic calendar axes, and a low-rank factorization is estimated using an L1 loading penalty together with graph total variation over the resulting calendar graph. The method therefore produces sparse and locally coherent loading patterns that remain directly readable in their original temporal coordinates. Calendar-SPCA is evaluated on two independent smart-meter datasets with different sample sizes and temporal resolutions: GoiEner and Low Carbon London. A factorial experiment characterizes the complementary effects of sparsity and calendar coherence and examines robustness across sample size, latent dimensionality, and repeated fits. At rank 15, Calendar-SPCA retains 96.92% and 82.90% of the explained variance of rank-matched PCA in GoiEner and Low Carbon London, respectively, while producing mean loading sparsities of 61.95% and 81.50%. Comparisons with classical sparse PCA and SPCA-TV further show that Calendar-SPCA adds a systematic organization of the latent factors in the original calendar coordinates while preserving substantial low-rank information. The resulting components form coherent and complementary daily, weekly, seasonal, and jointly localized calendar patterns, with dataset-specific geometries across the two datasets.

中文摘要：本文提出Calendar-SPCA方法，将已知的多周期结构（日、周、年）直接融入低维表示学习中。该方法在日历图上结合L1惩罚和图全变差，生成稀疏且局部连贯的载荷模式。在两个智能电表数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持大部分主成分方差的同时，能产生具有日历意义的可解释成分。

研究启发（模型推断）：将领域先验的周期性结构嵌入降维过程，可以显著提升时空数据表示的可解释性，为城市能源或人口流动等周期性时空数据的分析提供了新思路。

相关度：70/100 提出一种结合日历周期结构的稀疏主成分分析方法，用于多周期时间序列的表示学习，与GIS中的时空数据挖掘和时间序列分析高度相关。

item.title: Tabular Deep Learning vs Classical Machine Learning for Urban Land Cover Classification
item.description:
中文标题：表格深度学习与经典机器学习在城市土地覆盖分类中的对比

作者：Muntasir Tabasum, Tanpia Tasnim, Md. Ekramul Islam, Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib

Abstract: Urban Land Cover (ULC) classification plays a crucial role in urban planning, environmental monitoring, and sustainable development. We study this task using the ULC dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, which includes tabular features derived from high-resolution aerial imagery across nine classes (e.g., roads, trees, grass, water). The dataset presents typical remote sensing challenges, including high dimensionality, heterogeneous features, and class imbalance. In a unified, reproducible pipeline, we benchmark classical machine learning models (e.g., Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost) against Tabular Deep Learning (TDL) models (TabNet, FT-Transformer, TabTransformer, TabSeq, and 1D CNNs). To address class imbalance, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss for TDL models and evaluate performance using accuracy, macro-precision, macro-recall, macro-F1, AUC-ROC, and confusion matrices. Our results show that while tree ensembles remain strong general baselines, TDL models can match or exceed their performance when non-linear interactions are significant and imbalance handling is effective, providing complementary advantages for urban land cover mapping. See code: https://github.com/mtesha/tdl-vs-ml-urbanlandcover

中文摘要：城市土地覆盖分类在城市规划、环境监测和可持续发展中至关重要。本文使用UCI机器学习库中的ULC数据集，该数据集包含由高分辨率航空影像衍生的表格特征，覆盖道路、树木、草地、水体等九类地物，并具有高维、特征异质和类别不平衡等典型遥感挑战。作者在统一可复现的流程中，将逻辑回归、SVM、随机森林、XGBoost、CatBoost等经典机器学习模型与TabNet、FT-Transformer、TabTransformer、TabSeq和1D CNN等表格深度学习模型进行基准比较。为应对类别不平衡，TDL模型采用加权交叉熵损失，并使用准确率、宏精确率、宏召回率、宏F1、AUC-ROC和混淆矩阵评估性能。结果表明，树集成模型仍是强基线，但当非线性交互显著且不平衡处理有效时，TDL模型可达到或超过其性能，为城市土地覆盖制图提供互补优势。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，在城市土地覆盖分类中，表格深度学习并非普遍优于树集成，其优势依赖于非线性交互强度与不平衡处理策略；这为城市更新场景下多源特征融合与地物分类模型选择提供了可复现的评测参考。

相关度：72/100 该文直接面向城市土地覆盖分类，使用高分辨率航空影像衍生的表格特征，系统比较经典机器学习与表格深度学习模型，并处理高维、异质特征与类别不平衡等遥感常见问题，与城市更新、遥感变化检测及多源数据融合中的地物分类基础任务高度相关。

item.title: Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation with Large Language Models
item.description:
中文标题：图监督的分层临床对齐用于大语言模型放射学报告生成

作者：Yingshu Li, Yunyi Liu, Zhanyu Wang, Zailong Chen, Lingqiao Liu, Lei Wang, Luping Zhou

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：放射学报告生成受益于大语言模型，但临床忠实生成仍具挑战，因为现有监督主要在报告级别。本文提出图监督的分层临床对齐，将图像-报告监督重构为分层临床对齐问题，分解为疾病中心对齐和全局临床语义对齐。临床知识图谱作为训练时的结构先验，定义疾病特定的监督单元及其临床关系。在MIMIC-CXR、IU-Xray和COV-CTR上的实验表明，该方法在常规和临床指标上均持续提升性能，且3B模型超越了多个7B/13B骨干的先前系统。

item.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
item.description:
中文标题：ScienceBuddy：面向交互式科学智能体的递归中递归自改进

作者：Shuhan Xue, Jianyuan Zhong, Ziyuan Nan, Wenbin Li, Zhaochen Yu, Jinchao Ding, Qiang Gao, Pengyu Zhan, Yuntong Zhang, Tian Cheng, Zhenfei Yin, Yingcheng Wu, Ling Yang

Abstract: We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution evidence into tasks and evaluation rubrics for continual learning. At its core is recursive-in-recursive self-improvement, a paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning: the inner recursion improves the harness with the model fixed, while the outer recursion trains the model under the improved harness. Harness evolution shapes training experience, and model learning creates new opportunities for harness adaptation. We present case studies of researcher interaction, harness refinement, and model learning, with the benchmark cases spanning four scientific task families. By releasing ScienceBuddy as a research product, we make this paradigm available to the scientific community and take a step toward discovery intelligence: scientific AI that advances through sustained collaboration with researchers and evolves alongside the research it supports. Website: http://science-buddy.io

中文摘要：本文介绍并发布了ScienceBuddy，一个交互式科学研究工作区，将持续改进的科学智能体引入研究者的日常工作流。ScienceBuddy支持研究者执行科学任务，同时将其请求、反馈和执行证据转化为任务和评估标准，用于持续学习。其核心是递归中递归自改进范式，将工具链演化与模型强化学习耦合：内层递归在模型固定时改进工具链，外层递归在改进后的工具链下训练模型。工具链演化塑造训练经验，模型学习为工具链适应创造新机会。文中展示了研究者交互、工具链细化和模型学习的案例研究，基准案例涵盖四个科学任务族。通过将ScienceBuddy作为研究产品发布，作者使该范式可供科学界使用，并向发现智能迈进一步：通过与研究者持续协作而进步、与其支持的研究共同演化的科学AI。网站：http://science-buddy.io

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将LLM智能体的自改进机制与科学研究工作流结合，其递归自改进范式可能为地理空间智能中的智能体持续学习提供方法论参考，但摘要未涉及地理空间应用，需进一步验证其可迁移性。

相关度：55/100 该文提出ScienceBuddy交互式科学研究工作区，核心为递归自改进范式，结合LLM智能体与强化学习，与用户的LLM和多智能体研究兴趣高度相关，但其应用场景为通用科学任务而非地理空间领域。

item.title: Towards Detecting AI-Assisted Responses in Online Surveys
item.description:
中文标题：面向在线调查中AI辅助回答的检测

作者：Qizhou Wang, Bogdan Mamaev, Christopher Leckie

Abstract: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains underexplored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired with genuine human responses. Our evaluation of existing machine-generated text (MGT) detectors shows that naive AI usage is readily detectable, whereas persona-grounded agents that mimic entire respondents push detector performance toward chance. We further show that agentic completion cannot fully replicate respondent-level behaviour and leaves distinctive behavioural traces. While individual cues can be circumvented by targeted prompting, a simple few-shot, training-free aggregator over these cues improves mean AUROC by +0.14 over the best existing detector across agentic settings. Our project is available at https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURRE.

中文摘要：使用LLM完成在线调查会影响调查研究的有效性，但对此类使用的检测仍研究不足。作者引入初始基准数据集ASURRE，用于AI辅助调查参与，涵盖从完全生成、修改到基于人格的智能体化完成等使用策略。在这些策略控制下，使用多个LLM在三个不同学科的真实调查上生成LLM辅助的调查回答，并与真实人类回答配对。对现有机器生成文本（MGT）检测器的评估表明，朴素的AI使用容易被检测，而模仿完整受访者的人格化智能体使检测器性能接近随机水平。作者进一步表明，智能体化完成无法完全复现受访者层面的行为，并留下独特的行为痕迹。虽然单个线索可通过针对性提示被规避，但一个简单的少样本、免训练聚合器在这些线索上，在智能体设置下将平均AUROC较最佳现有检测器提升+0.14。项目见https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURRE。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，当LLM智能体被赋予人格设定时，其生成内容更难与人类区分，但行为层面仍可能残留可聚合的痕迹；这对依赖问卷或多智能体模拟的研究具有数据效度警示意义。

相关度：62/100 该文研究LLM与人格化智能体完成在线调查的检测问题，涉及LLM、智能体行为与数据真实性，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但应用场景为调查数据而非城市/地理空间数据，故相关性中等。

item.title: Zero-shot narrative detection in social messaging
item.description:
中文标题：社会信息中的零样本叙事检测

作者：Jes\'us M. Fraile-Hern\'andez, Anselmo Pe\~nas, Patrick Giedemann

Abstract: This study investigates the zero-shot ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify and classify hidden narratives in social messages. Our research hypothesis is that LLMs' extensive contextual knowledge allows them to interpret messages on a deeper, pragmatic level, going beyond basic sentiment or topic analysis. Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of training examples. In contrast, automatically generated descriptions or the use of few examples (few-shot) often degrade accuracy due to subtle shifts in framing. The study also finds that ensemble methods, particularly majority voting, enhance robustness and that larger models perform best while also being less sensitive to prompt variations. The findings validate that LLMs can effectively detect strategic narratives in a zero-shot setting, and when combined with simple ensembling and human-written descriptions, they can rival supervised systems, offering a scalable solution for narrative detection, specially when there is no training data for the vast majority of domains.

中文摘要：本研究考察大语言模型（LLM）识别和分类社会信息中隐藏叙事的零样本能力。研究假设是LLM广泛的上下文知识使其能够在更深层的语用层面解释信息，超越基本的情感或主题分析。在Dipromats和SemEval数据集上的实验表明，向模型提供人工撰写的叙事描述可显著提升性能，且无需训练样本。相比之下，自动生成的描述或使用少量样本（少样本）常因框架的细微变化而降低准确率。研究还发现，集成方法尤其是多数投票可增强稳健性，且更大的模型表现最佳，同时对提示变化较不敏感。研究结果验证了LLM可在零样本设置下有效检测策略性叙事，当结合简单集成和人工撰写描述时，可媲美监督系统，为叙事检测提供可扩展方案，尤其在大多数领域没有训练数据时。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究说明，LLM的零样本叙事识别高度依赖高质量的人工叙事描述，自动生成描述反而可能引入框架偏移；集成与人工先验结合是提升稳健性的关键。

中文标题：社会信息中的零样本叙事检测

作者：Jes\'us M. Fraile-Hern\'andez, Anselmo Pe\~nas, Patrick Giedemann

Abstract: This study investigates the zero-shot ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify and classify hidden narratives in social messages. Our research hypothesis is that LLMs' extensive contextual knowledge allows them to interpret messages on a deeper, pragmatic level, going beyond basic sentiment or topic analysis. Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of training examples. In contrast, automatically generated descriptions or the use of few examples (few-shot) often degrade accuracy due to subtle shifts in framing. The study also finds that ensemble methods, particularly majority voting, enhance robustness and that larger models perform best while also being less sensitive to prompt variations. The findings validate that LLMs can effectively detect strategic narratives in a zero-shot setting, and when combined with simple ensembling and human-written descriptions, they can rival supervised systems, offering a scalable solution for narrative detection, specially when there is no training data for the vast majority of domains.

item.title: Symbolic Separation: Grounding Deep Agents in Knowledge Graphs for Trustworthy Operational Data Analytics
item.description:
中文标题：符号分离：以知识图谱为深度智能体奠基以实现可信运维数据分析

作者：Baibek Davletiyarov, Junaid Ahmed Khan, Andrea Bartolini

Abstract: Generative AI promises natural language access to the massive numerical telemetry of data centers and Industry 4.0 installations, yet text-to-query and tool-using agents stay unreliable: even frontier models answer little more than half of real-world database questions, and far fewer of the multi-step, operational ones, because the LLM must compose how heterogeneous sources relate and hallucinates the relations, not just the fields. We propose symbolic separation: a deep agent reasons freely but may act on data only through an ontology-constrained Virtual Knowledge Graph with deterministic pre-execution validation. Unlike a tool API's interface contract, this domain-semantic contract turns a complex question into one validated graph traversal instead of LLM-inferred joins. Instantiated as the Neurosymbolic Deep Analyst and evaluated on 49.9 TB of superconputer telemetry against a rigid workflow and a non-symbolic ablation, it raises end-to-end task success from 43% to 86%, prevents silent data-integrity errors that no syntactic check catches, and cuts token cost by 2.4x, letting a smaller on-premise model outperform a larger one.

中文摘要：生成式AI有望为数据中心和工业4.0设施的海量数值遥测数据提供自然语言访问，但文本到查询和工具使用智能体仍不可靠：即使是前沿模型也只能回答略多于一半的真实世界数据库问题，对于多步骤运维问题则更少，因为LLM必须组合异构数据源之间的关系，并且不仅会幻觉字段，还会幻觉关系。本文提出符号分离：深度智能体自由推理，但只能通过本体约束的虚拟知识图谱对数据采取行动，并具有确定性的执行前验证。与工具API的接口契约不同，这种领域语义契约将复杂问题转化为一次经过验证的图遍历，而非LLM推断的连接。实例化为神经符号深度分析师，并在49.9 TB超级计算机遥测数据上针对刚性工作流和非符号消融进行评估，它将端到端任务成功率从43%提升至86%，防止了任何句法检查都无法捕获的静默数据完整性错误，并将token成本降低2.4倍，使较小的本地部署模型能够超越更大的模型。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文的符号分离架构——本体约束的虚拟知识图谱作为LLM智能体的确定性行动接口——对地理空间智能中多源数据融合与可信分析具有重要借鉴意义，尤其是城市更新中涉及多部门异构数据的复杂查询场景，可参考其将领域语义契约转化为验证图遍历的思路。

相关度：55/100 该文提出符号分离方法，将深度智能体与知识图谱结合用于可信运维数据分析，涉及LLM智能体、知识图谱和结构化推理，与LLM和多智能体、地理空间智能方向有较强的方法论关联。

item.title: Bi-FlowGS: Bridging Generative View Completion and Gaussian Geometry through Bidirectional Flow Co-Refinement
item.description:
中文标题：Bi-FlowGS：通过双向流协同细化桥接生成式视图补全与高斯几何

作者：Yuetong Wang, Jinsheng Quan, Yi Yang, Yawei Luo

Abstract: Sparse-view 3D scene reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is inherently underconstrained. Plausible renderings can also coexist with erroneous Gaussian geometry, as errors in positions or depths may be concealed by opacity, scale, and appearance; we term this failure mode Geometry Cheating. Existing regularization methods constrain geometry but remain limited to observed views, while video-diffusion-based methods complete unseen views yet mainly use them as RGB pseudo-supervision, underusing motion and temporal priors and lacking explicit geometry supervision. We present Bi-FlowGS, which uses optical flow to bridge generative view completion and Gaussian geometry regularization. Our plug-and-play Video-to-Geometry Flow Distillation (V2G) distills temporal correspondence priors from restored videos into Gaussian geometry to alleviate Geometry Cheating. Conversely, Geometry-to-Video Flow-Guided Restoration (G2V) uses the current 3DGS geometry to guide temporally consistent video restoration, providing more reliable generative supervision. Together, V2G and G2V form an implicit bidirectional co-refinement process, enabling restored videos and the optimized 3DGS scene to iteratively improve each other. Experiments demonstrate improved rendering quality and geometric consistency across wide-baseline and unbounded 360{\deg} benchmarks.

中文摘要：稀疏视图下的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建本质上是欠约束的，合理的渲染结果可能与错误的高斯几何并存，因为位置或深度误差可能被不透明度、尺度和外观所掩盖，作者将这一失效模式称为“几何作弊”。现有正则化方法仅约束已观测视图，而基于视频扩散的方法虽能补全未见视图，却主要将其用作RGB伪监督，未充分利用运动与时间先验，也缺乏显式几何监督。本文提出Bi-FlowGS，利用光流桥接生成式视图补全与高斯几何正则化。其即插即用的视频到几何流蒸馏（V2G）将恢复视频中的时间对应先验蒸馏到高斯几何中以缓解几何作弊；反之，几何到视频流引导恢复（G2V）利用当前3DGS几何引导时间一致的视频恢复，提供更可靠的生成式监督。V2G与G2V共同构成隐式双向协同细化过程，使恢复视频与优化后的3DGS场景相互迭代提升。实验表明，在大基线及无界360度基准上，渲染质量与几何一致性均有提升。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示，在三维场景重建中引入视频扩散模型的时间对应先验，可作为几何正则化的补充信号；其双向协同细化思路或可迁移至城市三维建模与遥感变化检测中的多时相几何一致性约束，但摘要未给出与地理空间数据的直接验证。

相关度：62/100 该文聚焦稀疏视图三维重建与3D高斯几何一致性，属于遥感变化检测与地理空间智能中三维场景建模的底层方法，但与城市更新、时空数据挖掘、LLM多智能体的直接关联较弱。

item.title: BeWater: Effective Protesters Navigate Watersheds in Street Networks
item.description:
中文标题：BeWater：抗议者在街道网络中的有效分水岭导航

作者：Guillaume Moinard, Matthieu Latapy

Abstract: During social movements, protesters need to gather with limited communication means and limited knowledge other than what they observe in their direct surroundings. We propose BeWater, a fully distributed walking protocol that achieves gathering thanks to city information like street length, number of restaurants, number of lanes, or street names. Even though using only one of these observables performs poorly, we show that combining them in more advanced tactics rapidly leads to groups of significant sizes. To do so, our work leverages OpenStreetMap data to perform experiments on several real-world cities.

中文摘要：在社会运动中，抗议者需要在通信手段有限、除直接观察外知识有限的情况下聚集。本文提出BeWater，一种完全分布式的行走协议，借助街道长度、餐馆数量、车道数或街道名称等城市信息实现聚集。尽管仅使用其中任一可观测信息效果不佳，作者表明将其组合为更高级的策略可迅速形成规模可观的群体。为此，该工作利用OpenStreetMap数据在多个真实城市开展实验。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究展示了OSM多属性街道信息在分布式空间决策中的组合价值，其思路或可启发城市更新中基于街道网络特征的人群流动模拟与应急疏散研究；但摘要未涉及城市更新或遥感数据。

相关度：58/100 该文利用OpenStreetMap街道网络数据研究城市中人群聚集的分布式行走协议，涉及城市空间信息与网络分析，与GIS和城市研究相关，但不涉及城市更新、遥感或LLM。

item.title: Can LLMs Follow the Pulse of a Crisis? Evaluating Crisis Sentiment in Bangladesh's July Uprising
item.description:
中文标题：LLM能否把握危机脉搏？评估孟加拉国七月起义中的危机情感

作者：Md. Samiul Alim, Mahir Shahriar Tamim, Tanvir Ahmed Khan, Sharjil Khan, Rafia Ferdous Duti, Shahriyar Zaman Ridoy, Mohammad Ali Moni

Abstract: Crisis sentiment analysis is especially challenging for low-resource languages such as Bangla, where language, context, and public reaction shift rapidly. We introduce UNRESTSENT200K, a Bangla crisis sentiment dataset with approximately 200K Facebook and YouTube comments from the July-August 2024 Bangladesh uprising. The dataset covers five event-aligned phases, from early escalation and internet blackout to regime transition and a later flood crisis. Each comment is linked to its parent post, enabling evaluation with and without discourse context. All comments are annotated through a fully human process involving 14 native Bangla-speaking annotators and senior validation, achieving substantial agreement (kappa = 0.73, alpha = 0.71) and 94.2% blind-audit agreement. We benchmark fine-tuned encoders, prompted LLMs, and LoRA-tuned LLMs. Results show that parent-post context consistently improves performance, while temporal shift across phases causes large performance drops. Strong LLMs perform well, but still struggle with sarcasm, implicit political references, and phase-dependent meaning. UNRESTSENT200K provides a benchmark for studying context-aware and temporally robust sentiment analysis in low-resource crisis discourse. UNRESTSENT200K is available at https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT200K/

中文摘要：危机情感分析对孟加拉语等低资源语言尤为困难，因为语言、语境和公众反应变化迅速。本文提出UNRESTSENT200K，一个孟加拉语危机情感数据集，包含约20万条来自2024年7月至8月孟加拉国起义期间的Facebook和YouTube评论。该数据集覆盖五个与事件对齐的阶段，从早期升级、互联网封锁到政权过渡及随后的洪灾危机。每条评论与其父帖关联，支持在有和无话语语境下进行评估。所有评论通过14名孟加拉语母语标注者和资深验证者参与的完全人工流程标注，达到较高一致性（kappa=0.73，alpha=0.71）和94.2%的盲审一致率。作者对微调编码器、提示式LLM和LoRA微调LLM进行基准测试。结果表明，父帖语境持续提升性能，而跨阶段的时间偏移导致大幅性能下降。强LLM表现良好，但在讽刺、隐晦政治指涉和阶段依赖语义上仍有困难。UNRESTSENT200K为低资源危机话语中的语境感知与时间鲁棒情感分析提供了基准。数据集见https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT200K/。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究显示，社交媒体危机情感分析中时间阶段偏移会显著削弱模型性能，这一发现对城市事件时空数据挖掘中的非平稳性建模具有参考价值；其父帖语境增强思路或可迁移至地理社交媒体分析，但摘要未涉及地理空间特征。

相关度：55/100 该文构建孟加拉语危机情感数据集并评估LLM，涉及社交媒体时空事件分析与低资源语言，与时空数据挖掘和LLM方向相关，但不涉及城市更新或遥感。
item.content:encoded:
中文标题：LLM能否把握危机脉搏？评估孟加拉国七月起义中的危机情感

作者：Md. Samiul Alim, Mahir Shahriar Tamim, Tanvir Ahmed Khan, Sharjil Khan, Rafia Ferdous Duti, Shahriyar Zaman Ridoy, Mohammad Ali Moni

Abstract: Crisis sentiment analysis is especially challenging for low-resource languages such as Bangla, where language, context, and public reaction shift rapidly. We introduce UNRESTSENT200K, a Bangla crisis sentiment dataset with approximately 200K Facebook and YouTube comments from the July-August 2024 Bangladesh uprising. The dataset covers five event-aligned phases, from early escalation and internet blackout to regime transition and a later flood crisis. Each comment is linked to its parent post, enabling evaluation with and without discourse context. All comments are annotated through a fully human process involving 14 native Bangla-speaking annotators and senior validation, achieving substantial agreement (kappa = 0.73, alpha = 0.71) and 94.2% blind-audit agreement. We benchmark fine-tuned encoders, prompted LLMs, and LoRA-tuned LLMs. Results show that parent-post context consistently improves performance, while temporal shift across phases causes large performance drops. Strong LLMs perform well, but still struggle with sarcasm, implicit political references, and phase-dependent meaning. UNRESTSENT200K provides a benchmark for studying context-aware and temporally robust sentiment analysis in low-resource crisis discourse. UNRESTSENT200K is available at https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT200K/

item.title: SPEAR NeXT Causal Latent Forecasting Across Multiple Horizons for Spectral Temporal Earth Representation Learning
item.description:
中文标题：SPEAR NeXT：面向光谱时序地球表示学习的多跨度因果潜在预测

作者：Rajiv Ranjan, Udaiveer Singh, Shashank Tamaskar, Dharmendra Saraswat

Abstract: Earth observation is inherently dynamic, yet temporal information in many foundation models is learned through reconstruction, invariance, or retrospective sequence summarization. SPEAR NeXT is introduced as a compact pixel-wise multimodal spectral temporal foundation model in which temporal self supervision is formulated as past only, multi horizon latent Earth state prediction. Instantaneous states are first encoded by the pretrained SPEAR model from optical, radar, and environmental observations into compact 32 dimensional embeddings. Their temporal evolution is then modeled by a causally masked Trans former that predicts multiple future latent states from pre ceding observations. Relative temporal order is represented using Rotary Position Embeddings, while month and year embeddings encode seasonal phase and interannual con text.

中文摘要：地球观测本质上是动态的，然而许多基础模型中的时间信息是通过重建、不变性或回顾性序列摘要来学习的。SPEAR NeXT被提出作为一种紧凑的像素级多模态光谱时序基础模型，其中时间自监督被表述为仅使用过去信息的多跨度潜在地球状态预测。瞬时状态首先由预训练的SPEAR模型从光学、雷达和环境观测中编码为紧凑的32维嵌入。然后其时间演化由因果掩码Transformer建模，从先前观测预测多个未来潜在状态。相对时间顺序使用旋转位置嵌入表示，而月和年嵌入编码季节相位和年际上下文。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将时序自监督学习表述为因果潜在状态预测，结合光学、雷达和环境多模态数据，对遥感变化检测和多源数据融合研究具有直接参考价值，其多跨度预测框架可能为城市更新监测中的时序分析提供方法论借鉴。

相关度：75/100 该论文提出面向地球观测的谱-时序基础模型，通过因果掩码Transformer预测多时间跨度潜在状态，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合高度相关，属于地理空间智能核心方向。

item.title: CoAdapt: An LLM-based Framework for Adaptive Collaborative Perception in IIoT Robotic Swarms
item.description:
中文标题：CoAdapt：面向工业物联网机器人集群自适应协同感知的LLM框架

作者：Houssam Hajj Hassan, Antonia Maria Masucci, Lynda Zitoune (L2S), Salah-Eddine Elayoubi (L2S)

Abstract: Industrial IoT environments increasingly deploy autonomous mobile robots for tasks such as material handling, product assembly, or infrastructure inspection. In such deployments, collaborative perception enables robots to share LiDAR observations and collectively construct a richer model of their environment than an individual agent could produce alone. However, industrial environments are dynamic spaces where robot positions shift continuously, network bandwidth fluctuates, and the marginal contribution of robots to perception quality varies at runtime. Existing collaborative perception approaches are designed for static participation assumptions and cannot adapt to these dynamics without sacrificing either detection precision or communication efficiency. This paper presents CoAdapt, an adaptive collaborative perception framework for IIoT robotic swarms in which a Large Language Model (LLM) serves as a runtime fusion controller, jointly deciding which robots participate in the fusion process and which fusion algorithm to apply based on the current spatial configuration and network state. The LLM reasons over structured natural language descriptions of the scene derived from raw LiDAR point clouds, requiring no taskspecific training and generalizing to unseen swarm topologies. Evaluated on the OPV2V benchmark across 25 scenarios, our approach achieves a 38% reduction in communication cost while maintaining detection precision comparable to static baseline approaches.

中文摘要：工业物联网环境越来越多地部署自主移动机器人用于物料搬运、产品组装或基础设施巡检等任务。在此类部署中，协同感知使机器人能够共享LiDAR观测并集体构建比单个智能体单独产生的更丰富的环境模型。然而，工业环境是动态空间，机器人位置持续变化，网络带宽波动，机器人对感知质量的边际贡献在运行时变化。现有的协同感知方法针对静态参与假设设计，无法在不牺牲检测精度或通信效率的情况下适应这些动态。本文提出了CoAdapt，一种面向工业物联网机器人集群的自适应协同感知框架，其中大型语言模型（LLM）作为运行时融合控制器，根据当前空间配置和网络状态联合决定哪些机器人参与融合过程以及应用哪种融合算法。LLM对从原始LiDAR点云衍生的场景结构化自然语言描述进行推理，无需任务特定训练，并能泛化到未见过的集群拓扑。在OPV2V基准上跨25个场景进行评估，我们的方法在保持与静态基线方法相当的检测精度的同时，实现了38%的通信成本降低。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将LLM作为多智能体协同感知的运行时控制器，其基于空间配置和网络状态的自适应决策机制对多智能体系统在时空数据挖掘中的应用有参考价值，且涉及空间推理，但与城市更新和遥感变化检测的直接关联有限。

相关度：65/100 该论文提出基于LLM的自适应协同感知框架用于工业物联网机器人集群，涉及多智能体协作和LLM作为融合控制器，与多智能体系统和LLM应用相关，且涉及空间配置推理，与地理空间智能有一定关联。

item.title: HLC-GS: Risk-Map-Guided Height-Layer Consistency Gaussian Splatting for DSM Reconstruction from Optical Satellite Imagery
item.description:
中文标题：HLC-GS：面向光学卫星影像DSM重建的风险图引导高度层一致性高斯泼溅

作者：Jie Yang, Yingdong Pi, Qiyan Luo, Xiaoyu Wang, Lekang Wen, Mi Wang

Abstract: A Digital Surface Model (DSM) is a fundamental geospatial data product for representing the elevation of the Earth's surface. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for DSM reconstruction from multi-view optical satellite imagery due to its explicit scene representation and efficient optimization. However, in 3DGS-based DSM generation, alpha-weighted aggregation of Gaussian altitudes may blend splats from different height layers at the same rendered pixel or DSM sampling location, producing non-physical intermediate elevations and height-layer mixing errors. To address this problem, we propose HLC-GS, a risk-map-guided height-layer consistency Gaussian Splatting method for DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery. HLC-GS consists of a risk map module, a dominant-layer reliability correction module, and a secondary-layer suppression module. The risk map localizes high-risk pixels with abnormal height dispersion and unreliable dominant-layer responses, while the latter two modules regularize unreliable dominant-layer responses and suppress weakly supported far secondary-layer responses. Extensive experiments are conducted on the DFC2019 and IARPA2016 datasets. Compared with six state-of-the-art DSM reconstruction methods, HLC-GS achieves better overall accuracy. Compared with the latest and precision-enhanced EOGS, HLC-GS reduces the average MAE from 1.46 m to 1.18 m and the average RMSE from 2.78 m to 2.58 m over the evaluated scenes, while improving PAG$_{2.5}$ from 86.09\% to 88.61\%. Overall, these results demonstrate that explicitly modeling per-pixel height-layer consistency alleviates height-layer mixing and improves the geometric quality of 3DGS-based DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery.

中文摘要：数字表面模型（DSM）是表示地球表面高程的基础地理空间数据产品。近来，3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）凭借其显式场景表示和高效优化，在多视角光学卫星影像DSM重建中展现出可观潜力。然而，在基于3DGS的DSM生成中，高斯高度的alpha加权聚合可能在同一渲染像素或DSM采样位置混合来自不同高度层的高斯，产生非物理的中间高程和高度层混合误差。为解决该问题，作者提出HLC-GS，一种风险图引导的高度层一致性高斯泼溅方法，用于光学卫星影像DSM重建。HLC-GS包含风险图模块、主导层可靠性校正模块和次层抑制模块。风险图定位高度离散异常且主导层响应不可靠的高风险像素，后两个模块则对不可靠的主导层响应进行正则化，并抑制支撑较弱的远处次层响应。在DFC2019和IARPA2016数据集上进行了大量实验。与六种最先进的DSM重建方法相比，HLC-GS取得了更好的整体精度。与最新且精度增强的EOGS相比，HLC-GS在评估场景上将平均MAE从1.46米降至1.18米，平均RMSE从2.78米降至2.58米，同时将PAG$_{2.5}$从86.09%提升至88.61%。总体而言，这些结果表明，显式建模逐像素高度层一致性可缓解高度层混合，并提升基于3DGS的光学卫星影像DSM重建的几何质量。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作揭示了3DGS在遥感高程重建中因多高度层高斯混合导致的非物理高程问题，其风险图引导的一致性正则化思路可推广至城市建筑高度估计与三维城市建模。

相关度：90/100 该文直接面向光学卫星影像的DSM重建，属于遥感三维重建与地理空间智能核心方向，与用户的多源数据融合、遥感研究高度契合。

Compared with the latest and precision-enhanced EOGS, HLC-GS reduces the average MAE from 1.46 m to 1.18 m and the average RMSE from 2.78 m to 2.58 m over the evaluated scenes, while improving PAG$_{2.5}$ from 86.09\% to 88.61\%. 中文摘要：数字表面模型（DSM）是表示地球表面高程的基础地理空间数据产品。近来，3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）凭借其显式场景表示和高效优化，在多视角光学卫星影像DSM重建中展现出可观潜力。然而，在基于3DGS的DSM生成中，高斯高度的alpha加权聚合可能在同一渲染像素或DSM采样位置混合来自不同高度层的高斯，产生非物理的中间高程和高度层混合误差。为解决该问题，作者提出HLC-GS，一种风险图引导的高度层一致性高斯泼溅方法，用于光学卫星影像DSM重建。HLC-GS包含风险图模块、主导层可靠性校正模块和次层抑制模块。风险图定位高度离散异常且主导层响应不可靠的高风险像素，后两个模块则对不可靠的主导层响应进行正则化，并抑制支撑较弱的远处次层响应。在DFC2019和IARPA2016数据集上进行了大量实验。与六种最先进的DSM重建方法相比，HLC-GS取得了更好的整体精度。与最新且精度增强的EOGS相比，HLC-GS在评估场景上将平均MAE从1.46米降至1.18米，平均RMSE从2.78米降至2.58米，同时将PAG$_{2.5}$从86.09%提升至88.61%。总体而言，这些结果表明，显式建模逐像素高度层一致性可缓解高度层混合，并提升基于3DGS的光学卫星影像DSM重建的几何质量。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作揭示了3DGS在遥感高程重建中因多高度层高斯混合导致的非物理高程问题，其风险图引导的一致性正则化思路可推广至城市建筑高度估计与三维城市建模。

相关度：90/100 该文直接面向光学卫星影像的DSM重建，属于遥感三维重建与地理空间智能核心方向，与用户的多源数据融合、遥感研究高度契合。

item.title: AsyncCouple-Flow: Asynchronous Cross-Modal Coupling and Flow Matching for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
item.description:
中文标题：AsyncCouple-Flow：面向时空预测的异步跨模态耦合与流匹配

作者：Zhixiang Wu, Yining Liu, Bo Zhao, Szu-Yu Chen, Huiran Duan, Chu Lin, Chuanguang Yang

Abstract: Multi-modal spatio-temporal forecasting (MM-STF) supports weather nowcasting, traffic prediction, and earth-system modeling by combining heterogeneous sources such as physical fields, satellite imagery, and in-situ sensors. Three obstacles persist: (i) modalities have different spatio-temporal sampling rates, forcing lossy interpolation onto a unified grid; (ii) modalities are frequently missing at deployment due to sensor outages or revisit gaps, while most methods train with full availability; and (iii) autoregressive decoders accumulate errors over long horizons, amplified by multi-modal conditioning. We propose AsyncCouple-Flow to address these issues jointly. A Modality-Aware Token Sparsification (MATS) module performs scale-aware tokenization and uses a shared importance scorer to select top-k tokens per timestep, producing equal-length sequences. An Asynchronous Cross-Modal Coupling Graph (ACCG) replaces fixed cross-attention with a learnable graph whose edges encode time offsets, semantic similarity, and modality-specific physical priors, enabling fusion under arbitrary asynchrony and missingness. A Flow-Matching Forecasting Head models multi-step prediction as a conditional ODE, trained with stochastic modality dropout and integrated jointly to avoid autoregressive drift. Experiments on ERA5+GOES+ISD weather forecasting and PEMS-BAY traffic prediction with multi-source side information show that AsyncCouple-Flow outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and remains robust with up to two missing modalities. The code will be released upon acceptance.

中文摘要：多模态时空预测（MM-STF）通过结合物理场、卫星影像和地面传感器等异构来源，支撑天气临近预报、交通预测和地球系统建模。目前仍存在三个障碍：（i）各模态具有不同的时空采样率，迫使进行有损插值以统一到同一网格；（ii）由于传感器故障或重访间隙，模态在部署时经常缺失，而大多数方法在全可用条件下训练；（iii）自回归解码器在长时程上累积误差，并被多模态条件放大。作者提出AsyncCouple-Flow以联合解决这些问题。模态感知token稀疏化（MATS）模块执行尺度感知的token化，并使用共享重要性评分器在每个时间步选择top-k token，产生等长序列。异步跨模态耦合图（ACCG）用可学习图替代固定交叉注意力，其边编码时间偏移、语义相似性和模态特定物理先验，从而在任意异步和缺失情况下实现融合。流匹配预测头将多步预测建模为条件ODE，并以随机模态丢弃进行训练并联合积分，以避免自回归漂移。在ERA5+GOES+ISD天气预报和带多源辅助信息的PEMS-BAY交通预测上的实验表明，AsyncCouple-Flow优于最先进基线，并在多达两个模态缺失时仍保持鲁棒。代码将在接收后发布。

研究启发（模型推断）：其异步跨模态耦合图与流匹配预测头，为遥感与地面观测采样率不一致、数据缺失条件下的城市时空预测提供了可迁移的融合与抗漂移建模范式。

相关度：85/100 该文面向多模态时空预测，处理异步采样与模态缺失问题，与用户的时空数据挖掘、多源数据融合方向高度相关。

item.title: BLINDSPOT: A Benchmark for Safety and Refusal Calibration in Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
item.description:
中文标题：BLINDSPOT：长程工具使用智能体安全与拒绝校准基准

作者：Sadia Asif, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri, Momin Abbas, Tejaswini Pedapati, Prasanna Sattigeri

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long-horizon interactions involving tool use, persistent state, evolving authorization, and external environment feedback. In such settings, safety failures may emerge only after multiple turns, yet existing evaluations often reduce agent behavior to task or attack success, obscuring whether an agent acts, refuses, or remains appropriately calibrated as the interaction evolves. We introduce Blindspot, a benchmark for trajectory-level safety calibration of long-horizon tool-using agents. Blindspot evaluates complete user-agent-environment trajectories through adaptive adversarial interaction, stateful tool execution, and execution-grounded adjudication. Its current instantiation contains 22 attack families and 35 scenarios across seven domains, yielding more than 2,500 long-horizon trajectories with an average interaction length of 14.7 turns. Each trajectory is assigned one of five outcomes: Safe Completion, Correct Refusal, Unsafe Completion, Over-Refusal, or Indeterminate. Unlike fixed attack datasets, Blindspot is an extensible live-simulation framework in which attacks, scenarios, tools, policies, domains, and agent configurations can be added without redesigning the evaluation pipeline. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs using eight metrics covering unsafe completion, appropriate refusal, benign utility, over-refusal, repeated-run robustness, and post-refusal failure. Preliminary results reveal substantial differences in safety-utility calibration across models and show that failures can emerge only after several initially safe interaction steps. These findings motivate treating agent safety as a trajectory-level property rather than a single-turn or binary success criterion.

中文摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在涉及工具使用、持久状态、动态授权和外部环境反馈的长程交互中运行。在此类场景中，安全失效可能仅在多轮交互后才出现，然而现有评估往往将智能体行为简化为任务或攻击成功率，掩盖了智能体在交互演化过程中是行动、拒绝还是保持适当校准。我们提出Blindspot，一个用于长程工具使用智能体轨迹级安全校准的基准。Blindspot通过自适应对抗交互、有状态工具执行和执行锚定的裁决来评估完整的用户-智能体-环境轨迹。其当前实例包含7个领域的22个攻击家族和35个场景，产生超过2500条长程轨迹，平均交互长度为14.7轮。每条轨迹被赋予五种结果之一：安全完成、正确拒绝、不安全完成、过度拒绝或不确定。与固定攻击数据集不同，Blindspot是一个可扩展的实时仿真框架，可以在不重新设计评估流程的情况下添加攻击、场景、工具、策略、领域和智能体配置。我们使用八个指标评估了13个专有和开放权重LLM，涵盖不安全完成、适当拒绝、良性效用、过度拒绝、重复运行鲁棒性和拒绝后失效。初步结果揭示了模型之间在安全-效用校准上的显著差异，并表明失效可能仅在若干初始安全交互步骤之后才出现。这些发现促使我们将智能体安全视为轨迹级属性，而非单轮或二元成功标准。

研究启发（模型推断）：该基准将智能体安全评估从单轮二元判断转向轨迹级校准，提示在城市更新等长程多智能体决策场景中，安全评估也需关注交互过程中的动态授权与状态演化。

相关度：62/100 该论文研究长程工具使用LLM智能体的轨迹级安全校准基准，与研究者关注的LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用，因此相关性中等。

item.title: Spurious Tool Use: When RL Agents Learn the Wrong Reason to Act
item.description:
中文标题：虚假工具使用：当RL智能体学会错误的行动理由

作者：Yiwei Yang, Haoxiang Zhang, Bingbing Wen, Yao Lu, Yuchen Wu, Lei Zhang, Julian McAuley, Pan Lu, Bill Howe

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interleave natural language reasoning with external tools such as web search and code execution. These tool-use policies are often optimized via reinforcement learning (RL), which can amplify spurious correlations in the training data. In this work, we study when and why RL-trained agents learn shortcut tool-selection policies: invoking tools based on superficial prompt cues rather than genuine task requirements. We construct controlled synthetic environments combining factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks, and inject cues that are strongly correlated with specific tools during training but causally irrelevant to tool necessity. Across counterfactual evaluations where cues are present but the associated tools are not required, agents exhibit substantial shortcut behavior, with spurious tool invocation rates increasing by up to 39 percent. However, shortcut formation is not universal: across the conditions we test, it arises only when the agent has already learned to use the target tool reliably, suggesting that task competence, rather than dataset imbalance alone, is a key factor in shortcut learning. A swapped-cue analysis further shows that semantic alignment between cues and tools substantially amplifies this effect. To mitigate these failures, we introduce a dense, decision-level reward in which an LLM judge evaluates the necessity of each tool call. This tool-necessity reward effectively suppresses cue-driven tool use while preserving task performance, providing a practical approach to improving the robustness of LLM agent tool-use policies.

中文摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地将自然语言推理与外部工具（如网络搜索和代码执行）交织在一起。这些工具使用策略通常通过强化学习（RL）优化，而RL可能放大训练数据中的虚假相关。在本工作中，我们研究RL训练的智能体何时以及为何学会捷径工具选择策略：基于表面提示线索而非真实任务需求来调用工具。我们构建了结合事实问答和数学推理任务的受控合成环境，并注入在训练期间与特定工具强相关但与工具必要性因果无关的线索。在反事实评估中，当线索存在但相关工具并非必需时，智能体表现出显著的捷径行为，虚假工具调用率最高增加39%。然而，捷径形成并非普遍现象：在我们测试的条件下，它仅在智能体已经学会可靠使用目标工具时才出现，表明任务能力而非仅数据集不平衡是捷径学习的关键因素。交换线索分析进一步表明，线索与工具之间的语义对齐显著放大了这一效应。为缓解这些失效，我们引入一种密集的决策级奖励，其中LLM评判器评估每次工具调用的必要性。这种工具必要性奖励有效抑制了线索驱动的工具使用，同时保持任务性能，为提升LLM智能体工具使用策略的鲁棒性提供了实用方法。

研究启发（模型推断）：工具必要性奖励可抑制线索驱动的虚假工具调用，提示在多智能体地理空间决策系统中，奖励设计需显式评估工具调用的因果必要性以避免捷径策略。

相关度：58/100 该论文研究RL训练LLM智能体中的虚假工具使用捷径行为，与研究者关注的LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间应用。

研究启发（模型推断）：工具必要性奖励可抑制线索驱动的虚假工具调用，提示在多智能体地理空间决策系统中，奖励设计需显式评估工具调用的因果必要性以避免捷径策略。

相关度：58/100 该论文研究RL训练LLM智能体中的虚假工具使用捷径行为，与研究者关注的LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间应用。

item.title: LLMs as Master Forgers: Generating Synthetic Time Series Data for Manufacturing
item.description:
中文标题：LLM作为大师级伪造者：为制造业生成合成时序数据

作者：Mantek Singh, Jeshwanth Challagundla, Prateek Karnal, Gagan Ganapathy, Vineet Shah, Ridam Arora

Abstract: This paper presents a novel framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate synthetic time series data for manufacturing processes. Motivated by the scarcity of labeled time-series data in real-world manufacturing settings, which hinders the development of robust machine learning models, we explore the potential of LLMs to learn complex temporal dependencies and generate realistic synthetic data. Our approach involves fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs on manufacturing process instructions and employing a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technique to enhance data diversity and realism. We evaluate our method against traditional time series modeling techniques like ARIMA and LSTMs, using quantitative metrics, PCA analysis, and downstream task performance (anomaly detection). Results demonstrate that our LLM-driven framework outperforms these baselines, generating high-quality synthetic time series data that effectively captures temporal dependencies and statistical properties of real manufacturing data, leading to improvements in downstream task performance.

中文摘要：本文提出一个利用大语言模型（LLM）为制造过程生成合成时序数据的框架。针对真实制造场景中标注时序数据稀缺、阻碍鲁棒机器学习模型开发的问题，作者探索LLM学习复杂时间依赖关系并生成逼真合成数据的潜力。方法包括在制造过程指令上微调预训练LLM，并采用检索增强生成（RAG）技术提升数据多样性与真实性。作者使用定量指标、PCA分析以及下游任务（异常检测）性能，将该方法与ARIMA、LSTM等传统时序建模技术进行对比。结果表明，该LLM驱动框架优于这些基线，能够生成高质量合成时序数据，有效捕捉真实制造数据的时间依赖与统计特性，并提升下游任务性能。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，LLM结合RAG可用于缓解标注数据稀缺问题并生成具有真实统计特性的时序数据；这一思路或可迁移至城市时空数据增强场景，但原文未涉及地理空间应用，迁移性属于推断。

相关度：62/100 该文利用LLM与RAG生成合成时序数据，与研究中时空数据挖掘、LLM及多智能体方向存在方法层面的关联，但其应用场景为制造业而非城市或地理空间，故相关性中等。
